results.question: For what reason may the network include the T3412 extended value IE?

results.question: What is the purpose of the T3412 extended value IE according to the clause?

> “If the ATTACH ACCEPT message contains the T3412 extended value IE, then the UE shall use the value in T3412 extended value IE as periodic tracking area update timer (T3412).”

results.question: In TS 24.301 clause 8.2.28.3, what does the Extended EMM cause IE indicate?

results.question: To which entity does the EMM entity forward the NAS message container contents?

results.question: What must be included in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message by the MME to trigger the condition for the replayed NAS message container?

results.question: Under what condition can the UE deactivate PSM?

results.question: What is the exception case where the UE does not include the CSFB response IE despite the service type indication?

results.question: During which procedures does the condition for including the replayed NAS message container apply?

results.question: When shall the Extended APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE be included in the message?

results.question: Which entity sends the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message?

results.question: What is the purpose of the integrity protection algorithm for NAS signalling messages?

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the replayed NAS message container?

results.question: According to the Device properties clause, when shall the UE include this IE?

results.question: What shall not happen as seen from the radio interface upon receipt of an EMM STATUS message?

results.question: What is the purpose of the Additional information information element?

results.model_answer: “The purpose of the Additional information information element is to provide additional information to upper layers in relation to the generic NAS message transport mechanism.”

results.reference: the generic message container type
results.model_answer: “The coding of the additional information value is dependent on the generic message container type.”

results.question: Under what condition may the UE include the Requested WUS assistance information IE?
results.reference: if it supports WUS assistance and it is not attaching for emergency bearer services
results.model_answer:
The UE may include the **Requested WUS assistance information IE** if it:

- supports WUS assistance; and
- is **not attaching for emergency bearer services**.

For a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST, the same condition applies: a WUS-capable UE may include it provided it is **not attached for emergency bearer services**.

results.question: When shall a UE initiate tracking area updating after an inter-system change from S101 mode to S1 mode?
results.reference: when the UE performs an inter-system change from S101 mode to S1 mode and has no user data pending
results.model_answer:
After an inter-system change from **S101 mode to S1 mode**, a UE in **EMM-REGISTERED** shall initiate tracking area updating **when it has no user data pending**.

If it has user data pending and the target tracking area is in the UE’s stored TAI list, it performs a **Service Request** procedure instead.

results.question: What is the only EMM procedure the UE can initiate when in NO-CELL-AVAILABLE state without PSM active?
results.reference: cell and PLMN reselection
results.model_answer: The UE shall not initiate any EMM procedure **except for cell and PLMN reselection**.

results.question: Under what conditions shall a network include the Packet flow identifier IE?
results.reference: If the UE supports A/Gb mode and BSS packet flow procedures, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode shall include this IE
results.model_answer: “If the UE supports A/Gb mode and BSS packet flow procedures, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode shall include this IE.”

results.question: What is the purpose of the ESM information request procedure?
results.reference: to provide privacy for the ESM information if ciphering is enabled in the network
results.model_answer: The ESM information request procedure allows the network to obtain ESM information—i.e. the APN, protocol configuration options, or both—from the UE during attach when the UE indicated that this information must be sent security protected. Its purpose is to provide privacy for that ESM information when ciphering is enabled.

results.question: What must a UE attached for access to RLOS do if it needs to initiate an emergency call?
results.reference: perform a local detach prior to initiating an attach procedure for emergency bearer services
results.model_answer: If a UE attached for access to RLOS needs to initiate an emergency call, **it shall first perform a local detach before initiating an attach procedure for emergency bearer services.**

results.question: According to which specification shall the UE perform cell selection/reselection in the NO-CELL-AVAILABLE case?
results.model_answer: The UE shall perform cell selection/reselection according to **3GPP TS 36.304**.

results.question: What mode must a UE be in for access to RLOS to be applicable?
results.reference: WB-S1 mode only
results.model_answer: Access to RLOS is applicable only to UEs in **WB-S1 mode**. UEs in **NB-S1 mode shall not request access to RLOS**.

results.question: Which network entity initiates the EPS bearer context modification procedure?
results.reference: the network
results.model_answer: The **network** initiates the EPS bearer context modification procedure; in EPS NAS this is initiated by the **MME** toward the UE (by sending a MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST).

results.question: When is the UE not allowed to include the Requested WUS assistance information IE?
results.reference: it is not attaching for emergency bearer services
results.model_answer:
The UE shall **not** include its UE paging probability information in the **Requested WUS assistance information IE** when:

- performing an **attach for emergency bearer services**; or  
- performing a **tracking area updating procedure while attached for emergency bearer services**.

results.question: What technical specification governs the cell selection/reselection procedure referenced in clause 5.2.3.2.6?
results.model_answer: The cell selection/reselection procedure is governed by **3GPP TS 36.304** (“E-UTRA User Equipment (UE) procedures in idle mode”).

results.question: What type of access to RLOS requests are supported for a UE attached for access to RLOS?
results.reference: UE originated access to RLOS requests
results.model_answer: For a UE attached for access to RLOS, **only UE-originated access-to-RLOS requests are supported**. Mobile-terminated access-to-RLOS requests and network-triggered service requests are not allowed.

results.question: What is the purpose of the EPS bearer context modification procedure?
results.reference: to modify an EPS bearer context or packet flow description(s) of an existing EPS bearer context
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the EPS bearer context modification procedure is to modify an EPS bearer context with a specific QoS and TFT, or re-negotiate header compression configuration associated to an EPS bearer context.”

results.question: What shall the UE do on the fifth expiry of timer T3482 for a non-emergency PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST?
results.reference: abort the procedure, release the PTI allocated for this invocation and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
results.model_answer: On the fifth expiry of T3482, for a non-emergency PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST, the UE shall **abort the procedure, release the PTI allocated for that invocation, and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE**.

results.question: When is the Packet flow identifier IE mandatory for a network to include?
results.reference: If the UE supports A/Gb mode and BSS packet flow procedures, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode shall include this IE
results.model_answer: “If the UE supports A/Gb mode and BSS packet flow procedures, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode shall include this IE.”

results.question: What type of attach does a UE set in the ATTACH REQUEST message to request access to Restricted Local Operator Services?
results.reference: EPS RLOS attach
results.model_answer: The UE sets the attach type to **“EPS RLOS attach”** in the **ATTACH REQUEST** message.

results.question: When timer T3447 is running, when can the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message be sent if still necessary?
results.reference: when timer T3447 expires
results.model_answer: When T3447 is running, a **PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST** can be sent, if still necessary, **when timer T3447 expires**.

results.question: Besides the SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE, which other message is not a plain NAS message and shall not be included?
results.reference: SERVICE REQUEST message
results.model_answer: The **SERVICE REQUEST message** is not a plain NAS message and shall not be included.

results.question: What does the network indicate by including the EPS bearer context status IE?
results.reference: the EPS bearer contexts that are active for the UE in the network
results.model_answer: By including the **EPS bearer context status IE**, the network indicates **which EPS bearer contexts are active in the MME/network** (except when no EPS bearer context exists on the network side).

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the EPS bearer context status IE?
results.reference: if it wants to indicate the EPS bearer contexts that are active within the UE
results.model_answer: “Upon an inter-system mobility from WB-S1 mode to NB-S1 mode in EMM-IDLE mode, if the UE has at least one dedicated EPS bearer context in ESM state BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE, the UE shall locally deactivate any such dedicated EPS bearer context and shall include the EPS bearer context status IE in TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.”

results.question: What procedure shall the UE perform according to 3GPP TS 36.304 when in NO-IMSI state?
results.reference: cell selection
results.model_answer: In **EMM-DEREGISTERED.NO-IMSI**, the UE **shall perform cell selection/reselection according to 3GPP TS 36.304**.

results.question: Who always initiates and controls the EPS AKA procedure?
results.reference: the network
results.model_answer: “The EPS AKA procedure is always initiated and controlled by the network.”

results.question: When a UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2 changes configuration to prefer SMS over IP networks, is able to use SMS via IMS, and has no CS voice capability, what two actions must it take?
results.reference: transit from CS/PS mode 1 to PS mode 1 or from CS/PS mode 2 to PS mode 2; and detach for non-EPS services
results.model_answer:
- Transit from **CS/PS mode 1 to PS mode 1**, or from **CS/PS mode 2 to PS mode 2**; and  
- **Detach for non-EPS services**.

results.question: What does security protection of EPS NAS messages involve?
results.reference: integrity protection and ciphering of the EMM and ESM NAS messages
results.model_answer: Security protection of EPS NAS messages involves **integrity protection and ciphering of EMM and ESM NAS messages**.

results.question: Which specific NAS message type is explicitly stated as not being a plain NAS message and therefore not included?
results.reference: SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE
results.model_answer: “The SECURITY PROTECTED NAS MESSAGE and the SERVICE REQUEST message are not plain NAS messages and shall not be included in this IE.”

results.question: Which entity includes the EPS bearer context status IE to indicate active EPS bearer contexts?
results.reference: The UE
results.model_answer:
Both entities may include it, depending on the procedure:

- **UE** includes the **EPS bearer context status IE** in, e.g., a **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** (or Service Request) to report which bearer contexts it considers active.
- **MME/network** includes it in a **SERVICE ACCEPT** to indicate which EPS bearer contexts are active in the MME.

As stated: “the MME shall include an EPS bearer context status IE, indicating which EPS bearer contexts are active in the MME.”

results.question: How is operation of a network without ciphering achieved?
results.reference: by configuring the MME so that it always selects the "null ciphering algorithm", EEA0
results.model_answer: Operation without ciphering is achieved by configuring the MME to always select the **null ciphering algorithm EEA0**.

results.question: What procedures must a UE in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2 execute if it changes to prefer SMS over IP networks, can use SMS via IMS, and has voice domain preference for E-UTRAN set to "IMS PS voice only"?
results.reference: transit from CS/PS mode 1 to PS mode 1 or from CS/PS mode 2 to PS mode 2; and detach for non-EPS services
results.model_answer:
For a UE in **CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2**, if SMS is changed to be **preferred over IP networks**, the UE **is able to use SMS using IMS**, and the voice domain preference is **“IMS PS voice only”**, it shall:

- transit from **CS/PS mode 1 to PS mode 1**, or from **CS/PS mode 2 to PS mode 2**; and
- perform a **detach for non-EPS services**.

results.question: What is one reason, besides protocol configuration options, for the UE to include the ESM information transfer flag IE?
results.reference: wishes to provide an access point name for the PDN connection to be established during the attach procedure
results.model_answer: The UE may include the **ESM information transfer flag** to indicate that the **APN needs to be sent after NAS signalling security has been activated** between the UE and MME.

results.question: What is the purpose of transmitting the APN-AMBR to the UE?
results.reference: for possible uplink policy enforcement
results.model_answer: The APN-AMBR is transmitted to the UE **for possible uplink policy enforcement**.

results.question: What shall the UE initiate on the expiry of timer T3411?
results.reference: shall initiate a tracking area updating on the expiry of timer T3411
results.model_answer: The UE shall initiate a **tracking area updating procedure** on expiry of timer **T3411**.

results.question: What shall the UE perform at the expiry of timer T3444 or T3445 if configured for eCall only mode?
results.reference: shall perform the eCall inactivity procedure at expiry of timer T3444 or T3445 (see clause 5.5.4)
results.model_answer: The UE shall perform the **eCall inactivity procedure** at expiry of timer **T3444** or **T3445**.

results.question: What procedures shall a UE execute when its configuration on use of SMS changes while operating in PS mode 1 or PS mode 2?
results.reference: Transit from PS mode 1 to CS/PS mode 1 or from PS mode 2 to CS/PS mode 2. Combined tracking area update with IMSI attach, (with or without "SMS only")
results.model_answer:
While operating in PS mode 1 or PS mode 2, if the SMS configuration changes to **“SMS service is not preferred to be invoked over IP networks”**, or if the UE is **unable to use SMS using IMS**, the UE shall:

- transition from PS mode 1 to CS/PS mode 1, or from PS mode 2 to CS/PS mode 2; and
- perform a **combined tracking area update with IMSI attach**, with or without the **“SMS only”** indication.

results.question: In which message during the attach procedure shall the UE include the ESM information transfer flag IE?
results.reference: PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **ESM information transfer flag IE in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message** carried in the **ATTACH REQUEST** message.

results.question: To which entities does the mobility management sublayer provide connection management services?
results.reference: the session management (SM) sublayer and the short message services (SMS) entity of the connection management (CM) sublayer
results.model_answer: “The mobility management sublayer … provide[s] connection management services to the session management (SM) sublayer and the short message services (SMS) entity of the connection management (CM) sublayer.”

results.question: At which reference point are the EMM procedures for EPS services used?
results.reference: radio interface (reference point "LTE-Uu")
results.model_answer: The EMM procedures for EPS services are used at the **radio interface, reference point LTE-Uu**.

results.question: What is computed by the USIM during a successful EPS authentication procedure?
results.reference: the CK and IK
results.model_answer: During a successful EPS authentication procedure, the USIM computes the ciphering key **CK** and integrity key **IK**. These are used by the ME as key material to compute **KASME**.

results.question: What type of NAS message is included in the IE described in clause 9.7?
results.reference: a complete plain NAS message
results.model_answer: The IE contains a replayed **ATTACH REQUEST** or **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** message, coded without a NAS security header.

results.question: Under what condition can all EMM procedures described in this clause be performed?
results.reference: if a NAS signalling connection has been established between the UE and the network
results.model_answer: “All the EMM procedures described in this clause can only be performed if a NAS signalling connection has been established between the UE and the network.”

results.question: When does the UE include the Paging restriction IE according to clause 8.2.29.36?
results.reference: if the Request type is set to "NAS signalling connection release" in the UE request type IE and the UE requests the network to restrict paging
results.model_answer:
The **Paging restriction IE** is included by a **MUSIM UE** in an **EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST** or **CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST** when it requests either:

- **“NAS signalling connection release”**; or  
- **“Rejection of paging”**

in the UE request type IE, and the UE wants to request paging restriction (where the network supports paging restriction). It carries the UE’s paging-restriction preference.

results.question: What is the main function of the ESM sublayer?
results.reference: to support the EPS bearer context handling in the UE and in the MME
results.model_answer: “The main function of the ESM sublayer is to support the EPS bearer context handling in the UE and in the MME.”

results.question: When is the Device properties IE included by the UE according to clause 8.3.8.3?
results.reference: if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **Device properties IE** in a **PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST** when it is configured for **NAS signalling low priority**. The low priority indicator is set to *“MS is configured for NAS signalling low priority.”*

results.question: Under what condition is the APN-AMBR IE included in a message?
results.reference: when the network wishes to transmit the APN-AMBR to the UE for possible uplink policy enforcement
results.model_answer: The APN-AMBR IE is included **when the APN-AMBR has been changed by the network**.

results.question: According to the clause, what condition exists regarding the procedure transaction?
results.reference: No procedure transaction exists
results.model_answer: No procedure transaction exists.

results.question: Under what condition regarding emergency services must the network include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE?
results.reference: the UE is not attaching for emergency bearer services
results.model_answer: The network shall include the **Negotiated WUS assistance information IE** only when the UE **is not attaching for emergency bearer services** (in addition to both UE and MME supporting and accepting WUS assistance).

results.question: When must the network include the Negotiated WUS assistance information IE according to clause 8.2.26.27?
results.reference: the UE supports WUS assistance, the MME supports and accepts the use of WUS assistance; and the UE is not attaching for emergency bearer services
results.model_answer:
The network shall include the **Negotiated WUS assistance information IE** if:

- the UE supports WUS assistance;
- the MME supports and accepts use of WUS assistance; and
- the UE is **not attaching for emergency bearer services**.

results.question: What type of pending messages must a UE have to include the NAS message container IE?
results.reference: pending SMS messages to be sent
results.model_answer:
The UE includes the **NAS message container IE when it has a pending SMS message to send** (using a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST).

> “If the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message is for sending SMS, the UE shall include the SMS message in the NAS message container IE …”

results.question: Which 3GPP specification is referenced for network-based IP flow mobility?
Under what condition shall the UE include the GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE during an inter-system change?
results.reference: if the UE performs an A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode inter-system change in EMM-IDLE mode and the TIN indicates "P-TMSI"
results.model_answer:
The UE shall include the **GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE** in the **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** when:

- the tracking area updating procedure is initiated in **EMM-IDLE mode** to perform an inter-system change from **A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode**; and
- the **TIN is set to “P-TMSI.”**

In that case, it also includes a **nonceUE**.

results.question: What is the full name of the substate described as being chosen while the UE searches for PLMNs?
results.reference: EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH
results.model_answer: **EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH**.

results.question: During which UE activity is the EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH substate selected?
results.reference: searching for PLMNs
results.model_answer: “The substate EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH is chosen in the UE, while the UE is searching for PLMNs.”

results.question: In which UE state is the substate EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH chosen?
results.reference: while the UE is searching for PLMNs
results.model_answer: “The substate EMM-REGISTERED.PLMN-SEARCH is chosen in the UE, while the UE is searching for PLMNs.”

results.question: Under what condition does a UE move to EMM-DEREGISTERED and GMM-DEREGISTERED during an intersystem change from A/Gb or Iu mode to S1 mode with no active PDP context?
results.reference: if EMM-REGISTERED without PDN connection is not supported by the UE or the MME
results.model_answer: At intersystem change from A/Gb or Iu mode to S1 mode with no active PDP context, the UE moves to **EMM-DEREGISTERED** and **GMM-DEREGISTERED** **if EMM-REGISTERED without a PDN connection is not supported by either the UE or the MME**. It then initiates an attach procedure.

results.question: When is a default EPS bearer context activated?
results.reference: when the UE requests a connection to a PDN
results.model_answer:
“A default EPS bearer context is activated when the UE requests a connection to a PDN.”

It may be activated during the EPS attach procedure for the first PDN connection, or after attach in response to a stand-alone PDN connectivity request; a separate default bearer is activated for each additional PDN connection.

results.question: What is the full name of the technology associated with the NBIFOM container?
results.reference: network-based IP flow mobility
results.model_answer: NBIFOM stands for **Network-Based IP Flow Mobility**.

results.question: What EMM cause value is set in the ATTACH REJECT message when it is combined with a PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT message?
results.reference: #19 "ESM failure"
results.model_answer: When the ATTACH REJECT is combined with a PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT in the ESM message container, the EMM cause is set to **#19, “ESM failure.”**

results.question: What action does the UE take on the first expiry of timer T3493?
results.reference: the UE shall resend the REMOTE UE REPORT message and shall reset and restart timer T3493
results.model_answer: “On the first expiry of the timer T3493, the UE shall resend the REMOTE UE REPORT message and shall reset and restart timer T3493.”

results.question: What two network conditions must be satisfied for including the T3324 value IE?
results.reference: the network supports PSM and accepts the use of PSM
results.model_answer:
The network shall include the T3324 value IE if:

- the UE included the T3324 value IE in the **ATTACH REQUEST** or **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** message; and  
- the network supports PSM and accepts the use of PSM.

results.question: How is the support of CE mode B by a UE indicated to the MME?
results.reference: by lower layers
results.model_answer: “The support of CE mode B by a UE is indicated to the MME by lower layers and shall be stored by the MME.”

results.question: When shall a UE that supports CE mode B and operates in WB-S1 mode not using satellite E-UTRAN access NOT apply the NAS timer values for WB-S1/CE mode?
results.reference: before receiving an indication from the network that the use of enhanced coverage is not restricted as described in this clause
results.model_answer: A UE that supports CE mode B and operates in WB-S1 mode **not using satellite E-UTRAN access** shall **not** apply the WB-S1/CE-mode NAS timer values **before receiving an indication from the network that use of enhanced coverage is not restricted**.

results.question: How many times is the retransmission repeated upon expiry of timer T3493?
results.reference: two times
results.model_answer: “This retransmission is repeated two times,” i.e. the UE retransmits on the first and second expiries; on the third expiry it aborts the procedure.

results.question: When does a UE maintain registration and related periodic update timers in both GMM and EMM?
results.reference: if the network has indicated that ISR is activated
results.model_answer:
“After successful completion of routing area updating or combined routing area updating and tracking area updating or combined tracking area updating procedures in both S1 mode and A/Gb or Iu mode, **if the network has indicated that ISR is activated**, the UE shall maintain registration and related periodic update timers in both GMM and EMM.”

An exception applies where the UE does not activate ISR (for example, a TAU triggered by a change in UE network capability); then it maintains only one registration and its related periodic-update timer in either GMM or EMM.

results.question: After aborting the Remote UE Report procedure, what is left to UE implementation?
results.reference: how to restart the procedure
results.model_answer: After abortion, restarting the Remote UE Report procedure for the remote UE(s) is left to UE implementation.

results.question: What does the UE do on the third expiry of timer T3493?
results.reference: the UE shall abort the procedure and release any resources for this procedure
results.model_answer: On the third expiry of timer T3493, the UE shall abort the Remote UE Report procedure and release any resources for that procedure.

results.question: What type of inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode is specified for the inclusion of the GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE?
results.reference: to S1 mode
results.model_answer: The GPRS ciphering key sequence number IE is included for an **inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode** (i.e., GERAN/UTRAN PS access to E-UTRAN/EPS).

results.question: When shall the UE include the NAS message container IE?
results.reference: if it is in EMM-IDLE mode and has pending SMS messages to be sent
results.model_answer: For case c of clause 5.6.1.1, when the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST is **for sending SMS**, the UE shall include the SMS message in the **NAS message container IE**. It shall not include an ESM message container IE in that message.

results.question: Under what conditions shall a UE that supports CE mode B and operates in WB-S1 mode not using satellite E-UTRAN access apply the NAS timer values for WB-S1/CE mode?
results.reference: the UE 's usage setting is not set to "voice centric" (see 3GPP S 23.401 [10]), and a) the use of enhanced coverage is not restricted for the UE; or b) CE mode B is not restricted for the UE (see 3GPP S 23.401 [10])
results.model_answer:
A UE that supports CE mode B and operates in WB-S1 mode **not using satellite E-UTRAN access** shall apply the applicable NAS timer value for WB-S1/CE mode when:

- the UE’s usage setting is **not** set to **“voice centric”**; and
- either:
  - use of enhanced coverage is **not restricted** for the UE; or
  - CE mode B is **not restricted** for the UE.

The UE shall not apply those WB-S1/CE-mode timer values before it receives a network indication that use of enhanced coverage is not restricted.

results.question: During what type of inter-system change is the NonceUE IE included?
results.reference: an A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode inter-system change in idle mode
results.model_answer: The **NonceUE IE is included during an inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode**, when creating a mapped EPS security context.

results.question: What is the EMM cause value when the attach request is rejected due to no suitable cells in tracking area and PDN connectivity reject is due to ESM cause #29?
results.reference: #15 "No suitable cells in tracking area"
results.model_answer:
The MME sends **ATTACH REJECT with EMM cause #15, “No suitable cells in tracking area”**, subject to operator policies.

It may additionally include the **Extended EMM cause IE** with value **“E-UTRAN not allowed.”**

results.question: What timer does the MME start when initiating the NAS security mode control procedure?
results.reference: timer T3460
results.model_answer: The MME starts **timer T3460** when it initiates the NAS security mode control procedure by sending the **SECURITY MODE COMMAND** message.

results.question: What security header type does the MME set in the SECURITY MODE COMMAND message?
results.reference: integrity protected with new EPS security context
results.model_answer:
The MME sets the SECURITY MODE COMMAND security header type to:

**“integrity protected with new EPS security context”**.

The message is integrity protected with the NAS integrity key of the indicated EPS security context, but is sent **unciphered**.

results.question: Which entity has initiated the EPS bearer context activation?
results.reference: The network
results.model_answer: The network (MME) has initiated the EPS bearer context activation.

results.question: When shall an MME that supports WB-S1 mode calculate the NAS timer values for WB-S1/CE mode for a UE not using satellite E-UTRAN access?
results.reference: the MME determines that a) the use of enhanced coverage is not restricted for the UE; or b) CE mode B is not restricted for the UE (see 3GPP S 23.401 [10])
results.model_answer:
When performing NAS signalling with a UE that supports CE mode B, operates in WB-S1 mode, and is **not** using satellite E-UTRAN access, the MME shall calculate the applicable NAS timer values for WB-S1/CE mode **if it determines that either**:

- the use of enhanced coverage is not restricted for the UE; **or**
- CE mode B is not restricted for the UE.

results.question: When is the ESM cause IE included in the message?
results.reference: when the UE requests the release of a dedicated bearer resource
results.model_answer:
The **ESM cause IE is included in a reject message** to indicate the reason the requested ESM procedure was rejected.

For example, when requested PDN connectivity cannot be accepted, the MME sends a **PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT** message, which **“shall contain the PTI and an ESM cause value indicating the reason for rejecting the UE requested PDN connectivity.”**

results.question: What is the purpose of the ESM message container information element?
results.reference: to enable piggybacked transfer of a single ESM message within an EMM message
results.model_answer: The purpose of the ESM message container information element is to enable piggybacked transfer of a single ESM message within an EMM message.

results.question: In what UE mode must the inter-system change occur for the NonceUE IE to be included?
results.reference: idle mode
results.model_answer:
The inter-system change must occur **in idle mode**:

> “This IE is included if the UE performs an A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode inter-system change in idle mode and the TIN is set to ‘P-TMSI’.”

results.question: Which substate indicates the UE is attached but out of coverage?
results.reference: NO-CELL-AVAILABLE
results.model_answer: **EMM-REGISTERED.NO-CELL-AVAILABLE** indicates that the UE is attached but out of coverage.

results.question: How shall the ESM message included in the ESM message container IE be coded?
results.reference: as specified in clause 8.3, i.e. without NAS security header
results.model_answer: “The ESM message included in this IE shall be coded as specified in clause 8.3, i.e. without NAS security header.”

results.question: What must the TIN be set to for the NonceUE IE to be included?
results.reference: "P-TMSI"
results.model_answer:
The TIN must be set to **“P-TMSI.”**

> “When the tracking area updating procedure is initiated in EMM-IDLE mode to perform an inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode and the TIN is set to ‘P-TMSI’, the UE shall include the GPRS ciphering key sequence number … and a nonceUE in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message.”

results.question: What type of information element is the ESM message container?
results.reference: a type 6 information element
results.model_answer: “The ESM message container is a type 6 information element.”

results.question: Where are the coding details for the ESM message container information element shown?
results.reference: figure 9.9.3.15.1 and table 9.9.3.15.1
results.model_answer: The ESM message carried in the ESM message container IE is coded as specified in **TS 24.301 clause 8.3**, **without a NAS security header**. The IE’s own coding is shown in **figure 9.9.3.15.1 and table 9.9.3.15.1**.

results.question: How many Extended Local Emergency Numbers lists can be present in the UE?
results.reference: only one Extended Local Emergency Numbers list
results.model_answer:
“There is only one Local Emergency Numbers List and only one Extended Local Emergency Numbers list in the UE.”

Therefore, **only one Extended Local Emergency Numbers List** can be present in the UE.

results.question: For what purpose may the network use the NAS signalling low priority indication?
results.reference: for NAS level mobility management congestion control and APN based congestion control
results.model_answer: “The network may use the NAS signalling low priority indication for NAS level mobility management congestion control and APN based congestion control.”

results.question: What type of bearer context activation has the network initiated?
results.reference: EPS bearer context activation
results.model_answer:
The network has initiated an **EPS bearer context activation procedure**—this may be either:

- **default EPS bearer context activation**, or
- **dedicated EPS bearer context activation**.

Both bearer-context activation procedures are network-initiated.

results.question: What shall the network include when the EPS QoS of the EPS bearer context is modified?
results.reference: the modified EPS QoS assigned to the EPS bearer context
results.model_answer: “The network shall include the modified EPS QoS assigned to the EPS bearer context.”

results.question: According to the clause, what may the network support?
results.reference: the Ethernet PDN type

results.question: What does the MME store within the default EPS bearer context if the NAS signalling low priority indication is provided in a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message?
results.reference: the NAS signalling low priority indication
results.model_answer: “The MME stores the NAS signalling low priority indication within the default EPS bearer context activated due to the PDN connectivity request procedure.”

results.question: What does the sender use as input to the ciphering algorithm?
results.reference: its locally stored NAS COUNT
results.model_answer: “The sender shall use its locally stored NAS COUNT as input to the ciphering algorithm.”

results.question: What type of information element is the Re-attempt indicator?
results.reference: a type 4 information element
results.model_answer: “The Re-attempt indicator is a type 4 information element with a length of 3 octets.”

results.question: Where is the content for the Supported codec list information element specified in TS 24.301?
results.reference: See clause 10.5.4.32 in 3GPP S 24.008 [13]
results.model_answer: The content of the **Supported codec list** information element is specified in **3GPP TS 24.008, clause 10.5.4.32**.

results.question: What are the two conditions that must both be true for the network to potentially include the Header compression configuration IE?
results.reference: the network accepts an IP PDN type; and control plane CIoT EPS optimization is selected
results.model_answer:
The network may include the **Header compression configuration IE** if both:

- **the network accepts an IP PDN type**; and  
- **Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization is selected**.

results.question: What are the two alternative UE capability conditions that mandate the inclusion of the Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting IE in WB-S1 mode?
results.reference: the UE supports CS fallback and SMS over SGs; or if the UE is configured to support IMS voice, but does not support 1xCS fallback
results.model_answer:
In WB-S1 mode, the UE shall include the **Voice domain preference and UE's usage setting** IE if it:

- supports **CS fallback or 1xCS fallback**; **or**
- supports **IMS voice over PS sessions**.

results.question: Which IE may the network include when both IP PDN type is accepted and a specific optimization is selected?
results.reference: Header compression configuration IE
results.model_answer:
The network may include the **Header compression configuration IE** when:

- an **IP PDN type** is accepted; and  
- **control plane CIoT EPS optimization** is selected.

results.question: Which external specification and clause define the Supported codec list content according to TS 24.301?
results.model_answer: The **Supported codec list** content is defined in **3GPP TS 24.008, clause 10.5.4.32**.

results.question: Under what condition is the header compression configuration IE included in the message?
results.reference: if the network wishes to re-negotiate header compression configuration associated to an EPS bearer context and both the UE and the network support Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and header compression
results.model_answer:
The Header compression configuration IE is included when header-compression configuration for an EPS bearer context is to be negotiated or re-negotiated, **provided that both the UE and the network support Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization and header compression**.

For initial UE PDN connectivity, it is included when the PDN type is IPv4, IPv6, or IPv4v6, the UE indicates Control Plane CIoT EPS optimization support, and the UE supports header compression.

results.question: What does the receiver use to form the NAS COUNT input to the deciphering algorithm?
results.reference: the NAS sequence number included in the received message (or estimated from the 5 bits of the NAS sequence number received in the message) and an estimate for the NAS overflow counter as defined in clause 4.4.3.1
results.model_answer: The receiver uses **the NAS sequence number included in the received message** (or estimated from the 5 transmitted sequence-number bits, where applicable) **and an estimate of the NAS overflow counter** to form the NAS COUNT input to the deciphering algorithm.

results.question: What is the length of the Re-attempt indicator information element?
results.reference: 3 octets
results.model_answer: “The Re-attempt indicator is a type 4 information element with a length of 3 octets.”

results.question: When an initial plain NAS message for transport of user data via control plane is to be partially ciphered, what is the length of the key stream set to?
results.reference: the length of the part of the initial plain NAS message (i.e. the value part of the ESM message container IE or the value part of the NAS message container) that is to be ciphered
results.model_answer: “The length of the key stream is set to the length of the part of the initial plain NAS message … that is to be ciphered,” i.e. the **value part of the ESM message container IE or the value part of the NAS message container IE**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the Re-attempt indicator information element?
results.reference: to indicate a condition under which the UE is allowed, in the current PLMN for the same APN, to re-attempt a session management procedure (see 3GPP S 24.008 [13]) corresponding to the EPS session management procedure which was rejected by the network
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the Re-attempt indicator information element is to indicate a condition under which the UE is allowed, in the current PLMN for the same APN, to re-attempt a session management procedure corresponding to the EPS session management procedure which was rejected by the network.”

results.question: What does TS 24.301 Clause 9.9.3.24 direct the reader to see for Network name information?
results.reference: See clause 10.5.3.5a in 3GPP S 24.008 [13]
results.model_answer: For Network name information, TS 24.301 clause 9.9.3.24 directs the reader to see **3GPP TS 24.008, clause 10.5.3.5a**.

results.question: What is the title of the clause that describes when no procedure transaction exists?
results.reference: PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
results.model_answer: **“No procedure transaction exists.”**

results.question: What are the input parameters to the NAS ciphering algorithm?
results.reference: the constant BEARER ID, DIRECTION bit, NAS COUNT, NAS encryption key and the length of the key stream to be generated by the encryption algorithm
results.model_answer:
The input parameters to the NAS ciphering algorithm are:

- Constant **BEARER ID**
- **DIRECTION** bit
- **NAS COUNT**
- **NAS encryption key**
- **Length of the key stream** to be generated by the encryption algorithm

For partial ciphering of an initial CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST, the key-stream length is the length of the part to be ciphered (the value part of the ESM message container IE or NAS message container).

results.question: What action shall the MME take if a NAS message is received without integrity protection after secure exchange has been established?
results.reference: the NAS shall discard this message
results.model_answer: Once secure exchange of NAS messages has been established, the MME NAS **shall discard** any NAS signalling message received without integrity protection.

results.question: Under what condition is TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST sent without integrity protection?
results.reference: if the tracking area updating procedure is initiated due to an inter-system change in idle mode and no current EPS security context is available in the UE
results.model_answer:
A **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** is sent **without integrity protection** when the TAU procedure is initiated due to an **inter-system change in idle mode from A/Gb or Iu mode to S1 mode**, and the UE has **no current EPS security context** available.  

In this case, the UE includes a **nonceUE** and **GPRS ciphering key sequence number** to enable creation of a mapped EPS security context.

results.question: What is described in clause 4.4.1 regarding EPS security contexts?
results.reference: the principles for the handling of EPS security contexts in the UE and in the MME and the procedures used for the security protection of EPS NAS messages between UE and MME
results.model_answer:
Clause 4.4.1 defines the **EPS security context** maintained by the UE and MME for NAS security. It includes, in particular, the \(K_{ASME}\) key, the eKSI, selected NAS ciphering and integrity algorithms and derived NAS keys, plus uplink and downlink NAS COUNT values.

It distinguishes:

- a **native EPS security context**, derived from EPS authentication; and  
- a **mapped EPS security context**, derived when interworking from another system (e.g. GERAN/UTRAN or 5GS).

The UE and MME maintain one **current** EPS security context for protecting NAS signalling, and can retain non-current security context information as specified for subsequent use.

results.question: What shall the MME do with a received NAS signalling message that fails integrity check after secure exchange is established?
results.reference: the NAS in the MME shall discard that message
results.model_answer: Once secure exchange of NAS messages has been established, the MME NAS **shall discard** any received NAS signalling message that has not successfully passed the integrity check. It shall not process or forward the message.

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the UE additional security capability IE?
results.reference: if the UE supports dual connectivity with NR or if the UE supports N1 mode
results.model_answer:
The UE shall include the **UE additional security capability IE** in an **ATTACH REQUEST** or **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** if it:

- supports **dual connectivity with NR**; or
- supports **N1 mode for 3GPP access**.

For a TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST, this applies **for all cases except periodic updating (case b)**.

results.question: How many times shall the network retransmit the IDENTITY REQUEST message upon expiry of timer T3470 before aborting the procedure?
results.reference: This retransmission is repeated four times
results.model_answer: The network retransmits the **IDENTITY REQUEST message four times**. On the **fifth expiry** of T3470, it aborts the identification procedure and any ongoing EMM procedure.

results.question: What information element is included by the UE in WB-S1 mode when requested in SECURITY MODE COMMAND?
results.reference: UE radio capability ID
results.model_answer: The UE includes the **UE radio capability ID information element** in the **SECURITY MODE COMPLETE** message.

results.question: In which mode shall the UE include the UE radio capability ID information element?
results.reference: WB-S1 mode
results.model_answer:
**WB-S1 mode.**

“The UE shall include this information element in WB-S1 mode if the UE radio capability ID was requested within the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message.”

results.question: Under what condition shall the MME retransmit the IDENTITY REQUEST message after an intra MME handover?
results.reference: upon successful completion of the intra MME handover the MME shall retransmit the IDENTITY REQUEST message
results.model_answer: If the IDENTITY REQUEST could not be delivered due to an intra-MME handover **and the target TA is included in the TAI list**, the MME shall retransmit it upon successful completion of that handover.

results.question: What type of information element is HashMME and what is its length?
results.reference: The HashMME is a type 4 information element with a length of 10 octets
results.model_answer: HashMME is a **type 4 information element** with a **length of 10 octets**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the HashMME information element?
results.reference: to transfer a 64-bit hash value to the UE so the UE can check the MME calculated value against the value locally calculated by the UE to determine whether the ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message sent by the UE has been modified
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the HashMME information element is to transfer a 64-bit hash value to the UE so the UE can check the MME calculated value against the value locally calculated by the UE to determine whether the ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message sent by the UE has been modified.”

results.question: In which clause is the condition for including the ESM cause IE specified?
results.reference: when the UE requests the release of a dedicated bearer resource
results.model_answer: The conditions for inclusion of the **ESM cause IE** are specified in the relevant ESM message descriptions in **clause 8** of TS 24.301.

results.question: How is the HashMME information element coded?
results.reference: as shown in figure 9.9.3.50.1 and table 9.9.3.50.1
results.model_answer: The HashMME is coded as a **type 4 information element** with a **length of 10 octets**. It transfers a **64-bit hash value**.

results.question: Which NAS messages can be processed by the MME without integrity protection before secure exchange is established?
results.reference: IDENTITY RESPONSE (if requested identification parameter is IMSI), SECURITY MODE REJECT, TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST
results.model_answer:
Before secure exchange of NAS messages is established, the MME may process the following NAS messages without integrity protection:

- **IDENTITY RESPONSE**, if the requested identity is the **IMSI**
- **SECURITY MODE REJECT**
- **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST**

In addition, a **DETACH REQUEST** may be sent without integrity protection in specific cases (e.g. emergency bearer services, RLOS, or cancelled attach), subject to the MME handling rules.

An **ATTACH REQUEST** may also be received unprotected, but for a non-emergency/non-RLOS attach the MME must authenticate the subscriber before further processing.

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the UE radio capability ID information element?
results.reference: if the UE radio capability ID was requested within the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **UE radio capability ID IE** in the **SECURITY MODE COMPLETE** message **if the UE radio capability ID was requested in the corresponding SECURITY MODE COMMAND message** (in WB-S1 mode).

results.question: In which 3GPP specification is the Mobile identity information located as referenced by TS 24.301 clause 9.9.2.3?
results.model_answer: The **Mobile identity** information element is specified in **3GPP TS 24.008**, clause **10.5.1.4**.

results.question: Which specific clause in TS 24.301 is identified as void?
results.reference: Clause 8.3.11.3
results.model_answer: Clause **5.5.2.3.3** of TS 24.301 is identified as **“Void.”**

results.question: What shall the UE not send when the maximum number of active EPS bearer contexts is reached and upper layers request connectivity to a PDN?
results.reference: a PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message
results.model_answer: “The UE shall not send a **PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST** message unless an active EPS bearer is deactivated.”

results.question: What does the UE provide to the network via the protocol configuration options when requesting a PDN connection for USS communication?
results.reference: CAA-level UAV ID
results.model_answer: The UE provides the **CAA-level UAV ID** to the network via the protocol configuration options. It may also provide the **USS address**, if supplied by upper layers.

results.question: Under what condition shall the Device properties IE be included?
results.reference: if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
results.model_answer:
The UE shall include the **Device properties IE** in the appropriate NAS message **when it is configured for NAS signalling low priority**.

The low-priority indicator is normally set to “MS is configured for NAS signalling low priority”; specified exceptions require it to be set to “MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority” (e.g. emergency services, paging response, AC 11–15 UE, or applicable dual-priority cases).

results.question: What happens to the associated PDN connection for USS communication if UUAA-SM fails during a re-authentication or re-authorization procedure?
results.reference: the associated PDN connection for USS communication is released
results.model_answer: “If UUAA-SM fails during the re-authentication or a re-authorization procedure … then the associated PDN connection for USS communication is released.”

results.question: If No E-UTRA Disabling In 5GS is enabled and the UE selects NG-RAN, what must it do regarding the E-UTRA capability?
results.reference: it shall not disable the E-UTRA capability
results.model_answer: If **No E-UTRA Disabling In 5GS** is enabled and the UE selects **NG-RAN**, **the UE shall not disable the E-UTRA capability**.

results.question: What is the UE's required action when a paging indication is received during an ongoing service request procedure?
results.reference: ignore the paging indication from the network
results.model_answer: “The UE shall ignore the paging indication from the network” when it is received during an ongoing service request procedure.

results.question: Which 3GPP specification clause is referenced for Mobile identity details in TS 24.301 clause 9.9.2.3?
results.model_answer: TS 24.301 clause 9.9.2.3 references **3GPP TS 24.008, clause 10.5.1.4** for Mobile identity details.

results.question: Where must the emergency numbers in the list be valid?
results.reference: valid within the same country as in the PLMN from which this IE is received
results.model_answer:
The emergency numbers in the **Emergency number list IE** are valid **only in networks in the same country as the PLMN from which the IE is received**.

For the **Extended emergency number list IE**, validity is either:
- within that same country; or
- only in the specific PLMN that sent it,

as indicated by the EENLV field.

results.question: What is the direction of the PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message?
results.reference: network to UE
results.model_answer: Network to UE.

results.question: What does the UE check using the HashMME value?
results.reference: the UE can check the MME calculated value against the value locally calculated by the UE
results.model_answer:
The UE compares the received **HASHMME** with a locally calculated hash of the **entire plain ATTACH REQUEST or TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** message that it sent to initiate the procedure.

This lets the UE determine whether that request message has been modified. If the values differ, the UE includes the original complete request message in the *Replayed NAS message container* of the SECURITY MODE COMPLETE.

results.question: For what purpose is the PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message sent by the network?
results.reference: to reject release of a PDN connection
results.model_answer: The PDN DISCONNECT REJECT message is sent by the network to reject the UE's request to release a PDN connection.

results.question: What is the message type for the message sent by the network to reject release of a PDN connection?
results.reference: PDN DISCONNECT REJECT
results.model_answer: PDN DISCONNECT REJECT.

results.question: What is the purpose of including the MS identity IE in a combined TA/LA update?
results.reference: to assign or unassign a new TMSI to a UE
results.model_answer: The **MS identity IE** is included in a combined TA/LA update **to assign or unassign a new TMSI to the UE**.

results.question: When may the MS identity IE be included during a combined TA/LA update?
results.reference: to assign or unassign a new TMSI to a UE
results.model_answer: The **MS identity IE may be included to assign or unassign a new TMSI to a UE during a combined TA/LA update.**

results.question: What triggers when timer T3402 expires after the tracking area updating attempt counter reaches 5?
results.reference: the normal tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and "SMS only" or the combined tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and "SMS only" is triggered
results.model_answer: When the tracking area updating attempt counter is equal to 5, the UE starts T3402. **On expiry of T3402, the normal tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and “SMS only”, or the combined tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and “SMS only”, is triggered.**

results.question: What timer does the MME start when initiating the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure?
results.model_answer: The MME starts timer **T3485** when initiating the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure.

results.question: When is the Device properties information element included according to clause 8.2.4.14?
results.reference: if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **Device properties** IE in the **ATTACH REQUEST** when it is configured for **NAS signalling low priority**.

results.question: What action can be performed on a TMSI using the MS identity IE in a combined TA/LA update?
results.reference: assign or unassign a new TMSI
results.model_answer: Using the **MS identity IE**, the network may **assign or unassign a new TMSI to the UE** during a combined TA/LA update.

results.question: In WB-S1 mode, what message does the MME send to initiate the dedicated bearer context activation procedure?
results.reference: ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST
results.model_answer: The MME sends an **ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST** message.

results.question: In WB-S1 mode, what does the UE do if access is barred for 'originating signalling'?
results.reference: The UE stays in the current serving cell and applies the normal cell reselection process.
results.model_answer:
In WB-S1 mode, the UE **shall not start the procedure** when access is barred for **“originating signalling.”** It remains on the current serving cell and applies normal cell reselection.

It starts (or restarts, as applicable) the procedure as soon as possible when originating-signalling access is granted on the current cell, or after moving to a cell where such access is granted.

results.question: What state does the MME enter after sending the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message?
results.reference: BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING
results.model_answer: After sending the **ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST**, the MME enters the state **BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING**.

results.question: When shall the UE include the UE additional security capability IE?
results.reference: if the UE supports dual connectivity with NR or if the UE supports N1 mode
results.model_answer:
The UE shall include the **UE additional security capability IE**:

- in an **ATTACH REQUEST**, if it supports either:
  - dual connectivity with NR (DCNR); or
  - N1 mode for 3GPP access; and

- in a **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST**, for all cases **except periodic updating only**, if it supports either:
  - DCNR; or
  - N1 mode for 3GPP access.

results.question: When the attach attempt counter is equal to 5, what shall the UE do regarding radio access technology selection?
results.reference: the UE shall attempt to select GERAN, UTRAN or NG-RAN radio access technology and proceed with appropriate GMM or 5GMM specific procedures.
results.model_answer:
When the attach attempt counter is equal to 5, the UE shall attempt to select **GERAN, UTRAN, or NG-RAN** and proceed with the applicable **MM, GMM, or 5GMM** procedures.

If GERAN or UTRAN is selected, the UE may disable E-UTRA capability. If NG-RAN is selected, it shall not disable E-UTRA capability when **No E-UTRA Disabling In 5GS** is enabled; otherwise it may disable it.

results.question: What identity value must the MME include in the ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message as the linked EPS bearer identity?
results.reference: the EPS bearer identity of the associated default bearer
results.model_answer: The MME shall include **the EPS bearer identity of the associated default bearer** as the linked EPS bearer identity in the `ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST` message.

results.question: Under what circumstance is the ESM cause IE included according to clause 8.3.10.3?
results.reference: when the UE requests the release of a dedicated bearer resource
results.model_answer:
The **ESM cause IE is included in an ESM reject message**—for example, a **PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT**—to indicate the reason that the requested ESM procedure or bearer/PDN operation was rejected.

In an attach failure case, the PDN CONNECTIVITY REJECT (including its ESM cause) can be carried in the **ESM message container** of an **ATTACH REJECT**; the ATTACH REJECT then uses EMM cause **#19 “ESM failure.”**

results.question: In which abnormal case does the UE receive a paging indication while a UE-initiated EMM specific procedure is ongoing?
results.reference: The paging indication received when UE-initiated EMM specific procedure or service request procedure is ongoing
results.model_answer:
The abnormal case is **paging for EPS services using IMSI** (an error-recovery procedure when the S-TMSI is unavailable due to network failure).

> “When a UE receives a paging for EPS services using IMSI from the network before a UE initiated EMM specific procedure has been completed, then the UE shall abort the EMM specific procedure…”

results.question: What are the two states in which the detailed behaviour of the UE is described in this clause?
results.reference: EMM-DEREGISTERED and EMM-REGISTERED
results.model_answer: “The detailed behaviour of the UE in the states **EMM-DEREGISTERED** and **EMM-REGISTERED** is described.”

results.question: What may the UE include to request the use of eDRX?
results.reference: this IE
results.model_answer: The UE may include the **Extended DRX parameters IE** to request use of eDRX.

results.question: What must be exceeded from clause 9.9.4.3 for the Extended EPS QoS IE to be included?
results.reference: the maximum value specified in the EPS quality of service information element
results.model_answer: For the Extended EPS QoS IE to be included, **at least one maximum or guaranteed bit-rate value to be transmitted must exceed the maximum value specified in the EPS quality of service information element in clause 9.9.4.3.**

results.question: For which entity is the detailed behaviour described in this clause?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: “In this clause, the detailed behaviour of the **UE** in the states **EMM-DEREGISTERED** and **EMM-REGISTERED** is described.”

results.question: Which bit rate values does the UE wish to transmit to the network for the Extended EPS QoS IE to be considered?
results.reference: the maximum and guaranteed bit rate values
results.model_answer:
The UE wishes to transmit the **maximum bit rate (MBR)** and **guaranteed bit rate (GBR)** values, i.e. the uplink and downlink MBR and GBR values.

The Extended EPS QoS IE is included only if at least one such value exceeds the maximum representable value in the EPS QoS IE (clause 9.9.4.3).

results.question: What does a UE in PS mode 2 use for non-EPS services?
results.reference: the procedures defined in the relevant 3GPP specifications for CS mode
results.model_answer: A UE in **PS mode 2** registers **only to EPS services** (with a data-centric usage setting); it does **not** use non-EPS services.

results.question: Which entity may include the IE to request eDRX use?
results.reference: The UE
results.model_answer: The UE may include the Extended DRX parameters IE to request the use of eDRX.

results.question: When timer T3402 expires, what procedure is triggered?
results.reference: the normal tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and "SMS only" or the combined tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and "SMS only" is triggered
results.model_answer: “When timer T3402 expires the normal tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and ‘SMS only’ or the combined tracking area updating procedure for EPS services and ‘SMS only’ is triggered.”

results.question: When the tracking area updating attempt counter is less than 5, what timer does the UE start?
results.reference: the UE shall start timer T3411
results.model_answer: When the tracking area updating attempt counter is less than 5, the UE shall start timer **T3411**.

results.question: Which timer does the UE stop when it receives the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message?
results.reference: stop timer T3493
results.model_answer: Upon receipt of the **REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE** message, the UE shall stop timer **T3493**.

results.question: What does the UE do upon receipt of the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message?
results.reference: stop timer T3493 and enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
results.model_answer: Upon receipt of the **REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE** message, the UE **stops timer T3493** and enters the state **PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the UE including the Extended DRX parameters IE?
results.reference: to request the use of eDRX
results.model_answer: The UE includes the **Extended DRX parameters IE** to **request use of extended idle-mode DRX (eDRX)** during an attach or tracking area updating procedure.

results.question: What technical document is cited for the Mobile identity content in TS 24.301 clause 9.9.2.3?
results.model_answer: 3GPP TS 24.008 is cited for the Mobile identity content.

results.question: What action does the network take upon receiving a DETACH REQUEST with 'switch off' indication during a network-initiated detach procedure?
results.reference: both procedures shall be considered completed
results.model_answer: “If the network receives a DETACH REQUEST message with ‘switch off’ indication, before the network initiated detach procedure has been completed, both procedures shall be considered completed.”

results.question: What does the MME do if it includes a new TMSI in the TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message and then receives a TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE message?
results.reference: sends an SGsAP-TMSI-REALLOCATION-COMPLETE message
results.model_answer:
Upon receiving the **TRACKING AREA UPDATE COMPLETE**, the MME:

- stops timer **T3450**;
- changes to state **EMM-REGISTERED**; and
- considers the allocated identities valid.

Specifically for the new TMSI: **“the MME sends an SGsAP-TMSI-REALLOCATION-COMPLETE message as specified in 3GPP TS 29.118.”**

results.question: What shall the receiving EMM or ESM entity in the UE not do once secure exchange of NAS messages has been established?
results.reference: shall not process any NAS signalling messages unless they have been successfully integrity checked by the NAS
results.model_answer: Once secure exchange of NAS messages has been established, the receiving EMM or ESM entity in the UE **shall not process any NAS signalling message unless it has been successfully integrity checked by NAS**. Any message that fails integrity checking, or is received without integrity protection, shall be discarded.

results.question: Which entity's response is the UE waiting for in the EMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED state?
results.reference: the MME
results.model_answer: The UE is waiting for a response from the **MME**.

results.question: Which messages are accepted by the UE without integrity protection in certain situations?
results.reference: IDENTITY REQUEST (if requested identification parameter is IMSI), ATTACH REJECT (if the EMM cause is not #25), DETACH ACCEPT (for non switch off), TRACKING AREA UPDATE REJECT (if the EMM cause is not #25), SERVICE REJECT (if the EMM cause is not #25)

results.question: What timer does the MME start when TMSI reallocation is part of the combined tracking area updating procedure?
results.model_answer: The MME shall start **timer T3450** when TMSI reallocation is part of the combined tracking area updating procedure.

results.question: Into which state does the UE enter after receiving the REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE message?
results.reference: enter the state PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE
results.model_answer: Upon receipt of the **REMOTE UE REPORT RESPONSE** message, the UE enters the state **PROCEDURE TRANSACTION INACTIVE**.

results.question: For case a in clause 5.6.1.1, what Control plane service type shall the UE indicate in the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message?
results.reference: "mobile terminating request"
results.model_answer: For case a, the UE shall indicate **“mobile terminating request”** in the Control plane service type of the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message.

results.question: Who is informed by the EPS additional request result IE?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer:
The **UE** is informed by the EPS additional request result IE:

> “The network may include this IE to inform the UE about the result of additional request.”

results.question: What shall the UE do if a NAS signalling message is received as not integrity protected after secure exchange is established?
results.reference: the NAS shall discard this message
results.model_answer:
The UE NAS shall discard the message.

> “If any NAS signalling message is received as not integrity protected even though the secure exchange of NAS messages has been established by the network, then the NAS shall discard this message.”

results.question: What are the two methods by which the UE and PDN GW can exchange protocol configuration options?
results.reference: via the dedicated ESM information request procedure or via other ESM procedures
results.model_answer:
The UE and the PDN GW can exchange protocol configuration options:

1. **Via the dedicated ESM information request procedure**; or  
2. **Via other ESM procedures**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the tracking area updating procedure when a UE enters S1 mode after CS fallback?
results.reference: to indicate that the UE enters S1 mode after CS fallback or 1xCS fallback
results.model_answer: The tracking area updating procedure is used **to indicate to the network that the UE enters S1 mode after CS fallback (or 1xCS fallback).**

results.question: In which UE substates does the tracking area updating attempt counter reset when a new tracking area is entered?
results.reference: the UE is in substate EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE or EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM
results.model_answer:
The tracking area updating attempt counter is reset when a new tracking area is entered if the UE is in either:

- **EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE**, or  
- **EMM-REGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-UPDATE-MM**.

results.question: What type of tracking area updating is used to periodically notify the availability of the UE to the network?
results.reference: periodic tracking area updating to periodically notify the availability of the UE to the network
results.model_answer: **Periodic tracking area updating** is used to periodically notify the availability of the UE to the network.

results.question: Under what condition does the MME retransmit the DETACH REQUEST message after a lower layers indication of non-delivery due to handover?
results.reference: upon successful completion of the intra MME handover
results.model_answer:
“If the DETACH REQUEST message could not be delivered due to an intra MME handover and the target TA is included in the TAI list, then upon successful completion of the intra MME handover the MME shall retransmit the DETACH REQUEST message.”  

It also retransmits it if handover failure is reported by lower layers and the S1 signalling connection exists.

results.question: What EMM state does the network change to upon aborting the detach procedure due to lower layer failure, if the detach type is not 'IMSI detach' or 're-attach not required' with cause #2?
results.reference: EMM-DEREGISTERED
results.model_answer: Upon lower layer failure, the network aborts the detach procedure and, unless the detach type is **“IMSI detach”** or **“re-attach not required” with EMM cause #2 “IMSI unknown in HSS”**, **shall change to state EMM-DEREGISTERED**.

results.question: What can be lost during inter-system mobility from NB-S1 mode to WB-S1 mode according to Note 1?
results.reference: the end-to-end support of the extended protocol configuration options IE
results.model_answer: During inter-system mobility from **NB-S1 mode to WB-S1 mode**, **end-to-end support of the extended protocol configuration options IE can be lost**, for example if the new MME does not support that IE.

results.question: What state does the UE enter after receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message during a combined tracking area update?
results.reference: MM IDLE
results.model_answer:
After accepting a combined tracking area update, the UE enters **EMM-REGISTERED** for EPS services. For the non-EPS/CS location-update part, it enters **MM IDLE** and sets the MM update status to **U1 UPDATED**.

> “The UE, receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message, stores the received location area identification, resets the location update attempt counter, sets the update status to U1 UPDATED and enters MM state MM IDLE.”

results.question: In which clause is the detailed behaviour of the UE in the states EMM-DEREGISTERED and EMM-REGISTERED described?
results.reference: In this clause
results.model_answer: “The detailed behaviour of the UE in the states EMM-DEREGISTERED and EMM-REGISTERED is described” in **clause 5.2**.

results.question: What does the UE set the update status to after receiving a TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT message?
results.reference: U1 UPDATED
results.model_answer:
Upon receiving a **TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT**, the UE sets the **EPS update status** to **EU1 UPDATED**.

For a combined TA/LA update, it also sets the non-EPS/MM update status to **U1 UPDATED** where the location update is accepted.

results.question: What type of information element is the Detach type?
results.reference: a type 1 information element
results.model_answer: “The Detach type is a type 1 information element.”

results.question: What is the purpose of the Detach type information element?
results.reference: indicate the type of detach
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the Detach type information element is to indicate the type of detach.”

results.question: What is the exception for processing ATTACH REJECT without integrity protection?
results.reference: if the EMM cause is not #25
results.model_answer:
An **ATTACH REJECT** received without integrity protection may be processed by the UE **provided that the EMM cause is not #25**.

> “ATTACH REJECT (if the EMM cause is not #25)”

results.question: What is the purpose of the EPS additional request result IE according to TS 24.301?
results.reference: to inform the UE about the result of additional request
results.model_answer: The EPS additional request result IE is used by the network to inform the UE of the result of the additional request.

results.question: Which clause defines the Detach type information element?
results.reference: TS 24.301, Clause 9.9.3.7, Detach type
results.model_answer: Clause **9.9.3.7** defines the **Detach type** information element.

results.question: What is described in this clause regarding the UE?
results.reference: the detailed behaviour of the UE in the states EMM-DEREGISTERED and EMM-REGISTERED
results.model_answer: This clause describes the EMM protocol of the UE and network using separate state machines. It introduces the UE EMM-entity states, and states that UE behaviour depends on the EPS update status.

results.question: To whom does the network transmit data when including the Extended protocol configuration options IE?
results.reference: to the UE
results.model_answer: The network transmits the data **to the UE** when including the Extended protocol configuration options IE.

results.question: What does the UE need to obtain for ciphered broadcast assistance data to include the Additional information requested IE?
results.reference: new ciphering keys
results.model_answer: The UE needs to obtain **new ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data**. It includes the **Additional information requested IE** with the **CipherKey** bit set to *“ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data requested.”*

results.question: What type of data can the network transmit using the Extended protocol configuration options IE?
results.reference: (protocol) data (e.g. configuration parameters, error codes or messages/events)
results.model_answer:
The network can use the **Extended protocol configuration options IE** to transmit **protocol data** to the UE, for example:

- configuration parameters;
- error codes; or
- messages/events.

This applies when extended protocol configuration options are supported end-to-end for the PDN connection.

results.question: Under what condition is the Forbidden TAI(s) IE included in the message?
results.reference: if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access
results.model_answer: The Forbidden TAI(s) IE is included **only if the message is sent via satellite E-UTRAN access**. It indicates forbidden TAI(s) to be stored either for roaming or for regional provision of service.

results.question: What shall the UE do if it receives an ESM message other than those listed in items a through j in which the message includes an unassigned or reserved EPS bearer identity value or a value that does not match an EPS bearer context of an established PDN connection?
results.reference: ignore the message
results.model_answer: “The UE shall ignore the message.”

results.question: What message shall the UE respond with if it receives a DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message which includes an unassigned or reserved EPS bearer identity value or an assigned EPS bearer identity value that does not match an existing EPS bearer context?
results.reference: DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT message with the EPS bearer identity set to the received EPS bearer identity
results.model_answer: The UE shall respond with a **DEACTIVATE EPS BEARER CONTEXT ACCEPT** message, with the EPS bearer identity set to the received EPS bearer identity.

results.question: What message and cause shall the UE respond with if it receives an ESM DATA TRANSPORT message which includes a reserved EPS bearer identity value or an assigned value that does not match an existing EPS bearer context?
results.reference: ESM STATUS message including ESM cause #43 "invalid EPS bearer identity"
results.model_answer: The UE shall respond with an **ESM STATUS** message including ESM cause **#43 “invalid EPS bearer identity.”**

results.question: Which specific EMM procedure can the UE initiate in this substate as a response to paging?
results.reference: service request
results.model_answer: The UE can initiate a **service request procedure** as a response to paging.

results.question: What must be true about the values to be transmitted for the Extended APN-AMBR IE to be included?
results.reference: at least one of the values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate information element in clause 9.9.4.2
results.model_answer: For the **Extended APN-AMBR IE** to be included, **at least one APN-AMBR value to be transmitted must exceed the maximum value representable in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE** (TS 24.301 clause 9.9.4.2).

results.question: What does the Back-off timer value IE request regarding procedure retry?
results.reference: a minimum time interval before procedure retry is allowed
results.model_answer:
The Back-off timer value IE requests the UE to **back off before retrying the same EPS session-management procedure** for the same PLMN and APN combination.
