As stated: “the UE is blocked from sending another ESM request for the same procedure for the same PLMN and APN combination for the specified duration.”

A non-zero, non-deactivated value starts the back-off timer; zero permits an immediate new attempt; and a deactivated timer prevents retry until the applicable clearing condition (normally UE switch-off or USIM removal).

results.question: Under what condition shall the Extended APN-AMBR IE be included in the message?
results.reference: if at least one of the APN-AMBR values has been changed by the network and at least one of the values to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value specified in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate information element in clause 9.9.4.2
results.model_answer: The Extended APN-AMBR IE shall be included **only if at least one APN-AMBR value has been changed by the network and at least one value to be transmitted exceeds the maximum value representable in the APN aggregate maximum bit rate IE (clause 9.9.4.2).**

results.question: For what type of assistance data does the clause specify conditions for including the Additional information requested IE?
results.reference: ciphered broadcast assistance data
results.model_answer: The clause specifies conditions for including the **Additional information requested IE to request ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data** (CipherKey bit set to “ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data requested”).

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the Additional information requested IE?
results.reference: if the UE supports ciphered broadcast assistance data and the UE needs to obtain new ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **Additional information requested IE** when it supports ciphered broadcast assistance data and needs to obtain new ciphering keys, **for all TAU cases except periodic updating (case b) and case zb**. The IE shall have the CipherKey bit set to *“ciphering keys for ciphered broadcast assistance data requested”*.

results.question: Who may send the Extended emergency number list IE?
results.reference: the network
results.model_answer: The network may send the **Extended emergency number list IE** in an **ATTACH ACCEPT** or **TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT** message.

results.question: What procedure shall a UE in LIMITED-SERVICE state perform regarding cell selection/reselection?
results.reference: shall perform cell selection/reselection according to 3GPP S 36.304 [21]
results.model_answer: “The UE shall perform cell selection/reselection according to 3GPP TS 36.304 [21].”

results.question: In what geographical scope can the emergency numbers in the Extended emergency number list IE be valid?
results.reference: valid within the same country as in the PLMN from which this IE is received or valid only in the PLMN from which this IE is received
results.model_answer:
The emergency numbers in the **Extended emergency number list IE** can be valid either:

- **in networks in the same country** as the PLMN from which the IE is received; or
- **only in the PLMN** from which the IE is received.

The applicable scope is indicated by the **Extended Emergency Number List Validity (EENLV)** field.

results.question: What shall a UE configured for eCall only mode do at the expiry of timer T3444 or T3445?
results.reference: shall perform the eCall inactivity procedure at expiry of timer T3444 or T3445 (see clause 5.5.4)
results.model_answer: It shall perform the **eCall inactivity procedure** (TS 24.301 clause 5.5.4).

results.question: While in the EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state, what is the UE waiting for?
results.reference: a response from the MME
results.model_answer: While in **EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED**, the UE is waiting for a **response from the MME** to the service request procedure.

results.question: When does the MME use the default APN as the requested APN?
results.reference: If no requested APN is included in the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST message or the ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE message and the request type is different from "emergency" and from "handover of emergency bearer services" and from "RLOS"
results.model_answer:
The MME uses the default APN **when no requested APN is included in either the PDN CONNECTIVITY REQUEST or the ESM INFORMATION RESPONSE, and the request type is neither**:

- “emergency”;
- “handover of emergency bearer services”; nor
- “RLOS”.

results.question: What is the name of the state a UE enters after starting the service request procedure while waiting for an MME response?
results.reference: EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED
results.model_answer: **EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED**.

results.question: When timer T3447 is running, when can the UE send the UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message if it is still necessary?
results.reference: when timer T3447 expires
results.model_answer: When timer **T3447** is running, the UE can send the **UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT** message, if still necessary, **when timer T3447 expires**.

results.question: When timer T3346 is running, when can the UE send the UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message if it is still necessary?
results.reference: when timer T3346 expires or is stopped
results.model_answer: “The UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message can be sent, if still necessary, when timer T3346 expires or is stopped.”

results.question: What does the Extended emergency number list IE indicate when sent by the network?
results.reference: a list of emergency numbers (with URN information) valid within the same country as in the PLMN from which this IE is received or valid only in the PLMN from which this IE is received
results.model_answer:
The **Extended emergency number list IE** encodes one or more local emergency numbers, each associated with:

- zero or more **sub-services** of the associated emergency-service URN; and
- a **validity indication** (EENLV), specifying whether the list is valid:
  - in networks in the same country as the sending PLMN; or
  - only in the PLMN that sent it.

results.question: What network capability triggers the inclusion of the LLC SAPI IE?
results.reference: a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode
results.model_answer: A network supporting mobility from **S1 mode to A/Gb mode** shall include the **LLC SAPI IE** when the UE supports A/Gb mode **and the negotiated LLC SAPI is modified**.

results.question: Under what condition can a UE send an UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT message when timer T3346 is running, if the UE is configured for dual priority?
results.reference: the UE is configured for dual priority and has a PDN connection established without low access priority but the timer T3346 was started in response to NAS signalling request with low access priority
results.model_answer:
If T3346 was started in response to a NAS signalling request with the low-priority indicator set, a dual-priority UE may send an **UPLINK GENERIC NAS TRANSPORT** message **when it has a PDN connection established without low access priority**.

Exact condition:

> “the UE is configured for dual priority and has a PDN connection established without low access priority but the timer T3346 was started in response to NAS signalling request with low access priority”

results.question: What action is controlled by the Back-off timer value IE in clause 8.3.9.3?
results.reference: procedure retry
results.model_answer: The Back-off timer value IE controls **when the UE may re-attempt the rejected ESM procedure**. While the indicated back-off applies, the UE is barred from sending another corresponding ESM request for the same **procedure, PLMN, and APN combination**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure?
results.reference: to establish a dedicated EPS bearer context between the UE and the EPC
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure is to establish an EPS bearer context with specific QoS and TFT between the UE and the EPC.”

results.question: What information is included with the emergency numbers in the Extended emergency number list IE?
results.reference: with URN information
results.model_answer:
The Extended emergency number list IE encodes one or more local emergency numbers **together with:**

- a **sub-services field**, containing zero or more sub-services of the associated emergency-service URN; and  
- a **validity indication**.

The associated URN is an emergency service URN with top-level service type **“sos”** (for example, `urn:service:sos.gas`).

results.question: What types of information may be sent and received while in the EMM-REGISTERED.IMSI-DETACH-INITIATED substate?
results.reference: User data and signalling information
results.model_answer: While in the **EMM-REGISTERED.IMSI-DETACH-INITIATED** substate, **user data and signalling information may be sent and received**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the EMM cause information element?
results.reference: to indicate the reason why an EMM request from the UE is rejected by the network
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the EMM cause information element is to indicate the reason why an EMM request from the UE is rejected by the network.”

results.question: After starting which procedure does a UE enter the EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED state?
results.reference: the service request procedure
results.model_answer: A UE enters **EMM-SERVICE-REQUEST-INITIATED** after it starts the **service request procedure**, i.e. after sending a **SERVICE REQUEST**, **EXTENDED SERVICE REQUEST**, or applicable **CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST** message and starting the relevant service-request timer.

results.question: How many octets long is the EMM cause information element?
results.reference: 2 octets length
results.model_answer: “The EMM cause is a type 3 information element with 2 octets length.”

results.question: What state does the UE enter after sending DETACH ACCEPT during the network-initiated detach procedure with 're-attach required'?
results.reference: enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED
results.model_answer:
After sending **DETACH ACCEPT** for a network-initiated detach with detach type **“re-attach required”**, the UE enters **EMM-DEREGISTERED** state.

> “The UE shall send a DETACH ACCEPT message to the network and enter the state EMM-DEREGISTERED.”

results.question: Under what condition is the DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE excluded during a periodic tracking area updating procedure?
results.reference: except when the UE performs a periodic tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer:
During a **periodic tracking area updating procedure**, the UE does **not** include the **DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode IE**, even if it intends to use or change its UE-specific NB-S1 DRX parameter.

> “In NB-S1 mode, a UE that wishes to use or change a UE specific DRX parameter in NB-S1 mode shall include its requested value in every TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message **except when initiating the periodic tracking area updating procedure**.”

results.question: What procedure must the UE initiate after completing the network-initiated detach with 're-attach required' and releasing the NAS signalling connection?
results.reference: initiate an attach or combined attach procedure
results.model_answer: The UE shall **initiate the attach procedure** (i.e. re-attach to EPS), after releasing the NAS signalling connection.

results.question: To what entity is a new DCN-ID assigned when the DCN-ID IE is included?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: A new DCN-ID is assigned to the **UE**.

results.question: In TS 24.301 Clause 9.9.3.24, which specific clause of 3GPP S 24.008 is cited?
results.model_answer: It cites **3GPP TS 24.008, clause 10.5.1.2**.

results.question: Under what condition is the EMM-REGISTERED.IMSI-DETACH-INITIATED substate entered?
results.reference: if the UE is attached for EPS and non-EPS services and wants to detach for non-EPS services only
results.model_answer: The UE enters **EMM-REGISTERED.IMSI-DETACH-INITIATED** after sending a **DETACH REQUEST** that is **not due to switch-off**, when the detach type indicates detachment for **non-EPS services only** (i.e. **“IMSI detach”**).

results.question: What type of information element is the EMM cause?
results.reference: type 3 information element
results.model_answer: “The EMM cause is a **type 3 information element** with 2 octets length.”

results.question: Which information element may be included to provide a new DCN-ID to the UE?
results.reference: DCN-ID
results.model_answer: The **DCN-ID IE** may be included to provide a new DCN-ID to the UE.

results.question: What are the two possible reasons for the UE entering the UPDATE-NEEDED substate?
results.reference: the access class is blocked due to access class control, or if the network rejects the NAS signalling connection establishment
results.model_answer:
The UE can enter **EMM-DEREGISTERED.UPDATE-NEEDED**:

- if its access class is blocked due to access class control; or  
- if the network rejects NAS signalling connection establishment.

results.question: Under what UE capability conditions may the MME include the Header compression configuration IE in the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST?
results.reference: If the UE indicated "Control plane CIoT EPS optimization supported" and "Header compression for control plane CIoT EPS optimization supported" in the UE network capability IE in the latest ATTACH REQUEST message or the TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST message, and the MME supports Control plane CIoT EPS optimization and Header compression for control plane CIoT EPS optimization
results.model_answer:
The MME may include the **Header compression configuration IE** in the **MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST** if the UE indicated, in the latest **ATTACH REQUEST** or **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** UE network capability IE, both:

- **“Control plane CIoT EPS optimization supported”**; and  
- **“Header compression for control plane CIoT EPS optimization supported.”**

In addition, the MME itself must support both capabilities.

results.question: What is the purpose of including the DCN-ID IE according to clause 8.2.16.3?
results.reference: to assign a new DCN-ID to the UE
results.model_answer: The DCN-ID IE is included to provide the UE with a new **DCN-ID** during the GUTI reallocation procedure. The UE stores it together with the registered-PLMN code in its DCN-ID list in non-volatile ME memory.

results.question: To which specific clause is the WLAN offload indication procedure specified?
results.reference: as specified in clause 9.9.4.18
results.model_answer: The WLAN offload indication procedure is specified in **3GPP TS 24.301, clause 9.9.4.18**.

results.question: What value shall any other value received by the mobile station be treated as?
results.reference: 0110 1111, "protocol error, unspecified"
results.model_answer: Any other value received by the mobile station shall be treated as **0110 1111, “protocol error, unspecified”** (EMM cause **#111**).

results.question: Which clause of TS 24.301 contains the Supported codec list information element?
results.reference: Clause 9.9.2.10
results.model_answer: Clause **9.9.2.10** of TS 24.301 contains the **Supported codec list** information element.

results.question: What must be set in the paging message's CN domain indicator when initiating paging for SMS?
results.reference: set to "PS"
results.model_answer: The paging message shall include the **CN domain indicator set to “PS”**.

results.question: How does a UE in EMM-IDLE mode using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization transport the first SMS message?
results.reference: by encapsulating it in the NAS message container IE in the Control Plane Service Request message
results.model_answer: It transports the first SMS message by encapsulating it in the **NAS message container IE** of a **CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST** message.

results.question: What shall the MME do if a NOTIFICATION message could not be delivered due to an intra MME handover and the handover is successfully completed?
results.reference: upon successful completion of the intra MME handover the MME shall retransmit the NOTIFICATION message
results.model_answer: Upon successful completion of the intra-MME handover, the MME **shall retransmit the NOTIFICATION message**.

results.question: What shall the UE initiate according to conditions given in clause 5.5.3.3 or clause 5.5.2.2.4?
results.reference: combined tracking area updating procedure
results.model_answer: The UE shall initiate a **combined tracking area updating procedure**.

results.question: Under what condition can the network initiate downlink transport of NAS messages procedure for a UE using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization?
results.reference: even if the UE does not have any PDN connections established
results.model_answer: For a UE using EPS services with control plane CIoT EPS optimization, the network can initiate the downlink transport of NAS messages procedure **even if the UE does not have any PDN connections established**.

results.question: Under what condition related to handover failure shall the MME retransmit the NOTIFICATION message?
results.reference: If a failure of the handover procedure is reported by the lower layer and the S1 signalling connection exists
results.model_answer: “If a failure of the handover procedure is reported by the lower layer and the S1 signalling connection exists, the MME shall retransmit the NOTIFICATION message.”

results.question: What is the purpose of the transport of NAS messages procedure?
results.reference: to carry SMS messages in an encapsulated form between the MME and the UE
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the transport of NAS messages procedure is to carry SMS messages in an encapsulated form between the MME and the UE.”

results.question: Which timers shall the MME not start for the paging procedure for SMS?
results.reference: timers T3413 and T3415
results.model_answer: For the paging procedure for SMS, the MME shall **not start timers T3413 and T3415**.

results.question: Which ESM cause value is used when the UE rejects the activation request due to an invalid EPS bearer identity?
results.reference: #43: invalid EPS bearer identity
results.model_answer: **ESM cause #43 — “invalid EPS bearer identity.”**

results.question: When shall the WLAN offload indication IE be included in the message?
results.reference: when the network wishes to indicate if the UE is allowed to offload the traffic of the associated PDN connection to WLAN(s)
results.model_answer:
The WLAN offload indication IE shall be included **when the network wishes to indicate whether the UE is allowed to offload traffic of the associated PDN connection to WLAN(s)**.  

It shall **not** be included when the MME deactivates all EPS bearer contexts of a PDN connection.

results.question: When can the transport of NAS messages procedure be used?
results.reference: when the UE is attached for EPS services and non-EPS services or for EPS services and "SMS only", and the UE is in EMM-CONNECTED mode

results.question: What ESM cause value does the UE send when rejecting an activation request due to a semantic error in the TFT operation?
results.reference: #41 "semantic error in the TFT operation"

results.question: Which procedure shall be performed at expiry of timer T3444 or T3445 if configured for eCall only mode?
results.reference: the eCall inactivity procedure
results.model_answer: The UE shall perform the **eCall inactivity procedure** at expiry of timer **T3444** or **T3445**.

results.question: When does the network initiate paging for an incoming mobile terminating SMS received outside the paging time window for a UE using eDRX?
results.reference: at T time ahead of the beginning of the next paging time window
results.model_answer:
If the SMS is received outside the paging time window, and the eDRX value provided by the network is not all zeros (i.e. E-UTRAN eDRX cycle length is greater than 5.12 seconds), the network initiates paging **at T time ahead of the beginning of the next paging time window**.  

“T” is a short, implementation-dependent period.

results.question: What is the purpose of the EPS update result information element?
results.reference: to specify the result of the associated updating procedure
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the EPS update result information element is to specify the result of the associated updating procedure.”

results.question: What type of information element is the EPS update result?
results.reference: a type 1 information element
results.model_answer: “The EPS update result is a type 1 information element.”

results.question: In which UE operating modes and state shall the combined tracking area updating procedure be initiated?
results.reference: The UE operating in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2, in state EMM-REGISTERED
results.model_answer: “The UE operating in **CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2**, in state **EMM-REGISTERED**, shall initiate the combined tracking area updating procedure.”

results.question: Under what condition does the network initiate paging for an incoming mobile terminating SMS when the UE is attached for EPS services with CIoT EPS optimization?
results.reference: the UE has requested "SMS only" and the UE is in NB-S1 mode

results.question: For cases n, zc and ze, when shall the UE set the URCIDA bit to "UE radio capability ID available" in WB-S1 mode?

results.model_answer: For cases **n, zc and ze**, in WB-S1 mode, the UE shall set the **URCIDA** bit to **“UE radio capability ID available”** in the UE radio capability ID availability IE **if the UE supports RACS and has an applicable UE radio capability ID for the new UE radio configuration in the selected PLMN**.

results.question: Which IETF-based method is specified for IPv4 address allocation and IPv4 parameter configuration?
results.reference: IPv4 address allocation and IPv4 parameter configuration via DHCPv4
results.model_answer: “IPv4 address allocation and IPv4 parameter configuration via DHCPv4.”

results.question: Under what condition shall the MS network feature support IE be included?

results.model_answer: The **MS network feature support IE shall be included if the UE supports the extended periodic timer T3412**.

results.question: Which IE shall be included when the UE supports extended periodic timer T3412?
results.reference: MS network feature support
results.model_answer: **T3412 extended value IE** shall be included if the UE supports the extended periodic timer T3412.

results.question: What action does the UE take if, during TFT error checking, the TFT operation is an operation other than 'Create a new TFT'?
results.reference: reject the activation request with ESM cause #41 "semantic error in the TFT operation"
results.model_answer: The UE shall reject the dedicated EPS bearer context activation request with ESM cause **#41, “semantic error in the TFT operation.”**

results.question: Under what configuration condition shall the UE perform the eCall inactivity procedure at timer expiry?
results.reference: if configured for eCall only mode as specified in 3GPP S 31.102 [17]
results.model_answer: The UE shall perform the eCall inactivity procedure at expiry of timer **T3444 or T3445** **if it is configured for eCall only mode as specified in 3GPP TS 31.102**.

results.question: What does the MME do upon receiving an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message while in state BEARER CONTEXT ACTIVE PENDING?
results.reference: stop the timer T3485, enter the state BEARER CONTEXT INACTIVE and abort the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure

results.question: What value is added to the NAS timer indicated in table 10.2.1 for a UE in NB-S1 mode?
results.reference: plus 240s
results.model_answer: For a UE in **NB-S1 mode**, the applicable NAS timer value indicated in table 10.2.1 is increased by **240 seconds**.

results.question: What mode must the UE support for the network to include the radio priority IE during S1 to A/Gb mobility?
results.reference: A/Gb mode
results.model_answer:
The UE must support **A/Gb mode**.  

“If the UE supports A/Gb mode, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode shall include this IE.”

results.question: According to NOTE 2, what specific access case is included in NB-S1 mode?
results.reference: satellite access
results.model_answer: “NB-S1 mode includes the case when **satellite access is used in EPS**.”

results.question: What shall the UE do if it receives an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST message with an EPS bearer identity identical to that of an already activated default EPS bearer context?
results.reference: the UE shall locally deactivate the existing default EPS bearer context and all the associated dedicated EPS bearer contexts, if any, and proceed with the requested dedicated EPS bearer context activation
results.model_answer: “The UE shall locally deactivate the existing default EPS bearer context and all the associated dedicated EPS bearer contexts, if any, and proceed with the requested dedicated EPS bearer context activation.”

results.question: What message and ESM cause shall the UE reply with if the linked EPS bearer identity in an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST does not match any activated default EPS bearer context?
results.reference: reply with an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message with ESM cause #43 "invalid EPS bearer identity"
results.model_answer: The UE shall reply with an **ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT** message with ESM cause **#43 “invalid EPS bearer identity.”**

results.question: What shall the UE do if the PLMN's maximum number of EPS bearer contexts in S1 mode is reached and it receives an ACTIVATE DEDICATED EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST?
results.reference: the UE shall clear the determination representing the PLMN 's maximum number of EPS bearer contexts in S1 mode and proceed with the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure
results.model_answer: The UE **shall clear the determination representing the PLMN's maximum number of EPS bearer contexts in S1 mode and proceed with the dedicated EPS bearer context activation procedure**.

results.question: What additional time is added to the timer in table 10.3.2 for an MME supporting NB-S1 mode?
results.reference: plus 180s
results.model_answer: For an MME supporting NB-S1 mode, the applicable NAS timer value in table 10.3.2 is increased by **180 seconds**.

results.question: When shall the UE set the RACS bit to "RACS supported" in the UE network capability IE?
results.reference: In WB-S1 mode, if the UE supports RACS
results.model_answer:
In WB-S1 mode, a UE that supports RACS shall set the RACS bit to **“RACS supported”** in the UE network capability IE of:

- the **ATTACH REQUEST** message; and
- the **TRACKING AREA UPDATE REQUEST** message.

results.question: Which clause of 3GPP S 24.008 is referenced for Daylight saving time details?
results.reference: clause 10.5.3.12
results.model_answer: 3GPP TS 24.008, clause **10.5.3.12** (“Network daylight saving time”).

results.question: What document is referenced for the specification of Daylight saving time?
results.model_answer: Daylight saving time is specified in **3GPP TS 24.008**.

results.question: When is the MS network feature support IE mandatory according to clause 8.2.29.22?
results.reference: if the UE supports extended periodic timer T3412
results.model_answer: The **MS network feature support IE shall be included in the ATTACH REQUEST if the UE supports the extended periodic timer T3412**.

results.question: Which entity includes the Remote UE Context Connected IE in the message?
results.reference: the UE acting as ProSe UE-to-network relay
results.model_answer: The **UE acting as a ProSe UE-to-network relay** includes the **Remote UE Context Connected IE** in the message.

results.question: When does an MME supporting NB-S1 mode calculate the NAS timer value for signalling with a UE using NB-S1 mode?
results.reference: at start of a NAS procedure
results.model_answer:
“When an MME that supports NB-S1 mode performs NAS signalling with a UE, which is using NB-S1 mode,” it calculates the applicable NAS timer value as the table-indicated value plus **240 s** (table 10.2.2) or plus **180 s** (table 10.3.2), as applicable.

“The NAS timer value shall be calculated at start of a NAS procedure and shall not re-calculate … until the NAS procedure is completed, restarted or aborted.”

results.question: What does the TAI list IE assign according to the provided clause?
results.reference: a TAI list
results.model_answer: The TAI list IE **assigns a TAI list to the UE**.

results.question: According to TS 24.301 clause 9.9.3.2, where should one look for the definition of the AUTN parameter?
results.model_answer: The AUTN parameter is defined in **3GPP TS 33.102** (Authentication and Key Agreement).

results.question: Which EMM cause values shall the network return in an ATTACH REJECT if the ATTACH REQUEST is received with a protocol error?
results.reference: #96: invalid mandatory information #99: information element non-existent or not implemented #100: conditional IE error; or #111: protocol error, unspecified
results.model_answer:
The network shall return an **ATTACH REJECT** with one of these EMM cause values:

- **#96** — *invalid mandatory information*  
- **#99** — *information element non-existent or not implemented*  
- **#100** — *conditional IE error*  
- **#111** — *protocol error, unspecified*

results.question: Under what condition does the network include the T3447 value IE when the UE has indicated support for service gap control?
results.reference: the EMM context contains a service gap time value
results.model_answer: The network may include the **T3447 value IE** only when a **service gap time value is available in the UE’s EMM context** (in addition to the UE having indicated SGC support).

results.question: According to the clause, where is the specification for the newly connected remote UE information provided?
results.model_answer: The newly connected remote UE information is specified in **3GPP TS 23.303**.

results.question: To which entity does the UE transmit data when using the Protocol configuration options IE?
results.reference: to the network
results.model_answer: The UE transmits the data to the **PDN GW or the SCEF**.

results.question: To which entity is a TAI list assigned by the TAI list IE?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: A TAI list conveyed in the **TAI list IE is assigned to the UE**. It defines the tracking areas in which that UE can be paged without performing a tracking area update.

results.question: What is the purpose of including the TAI list IE according to clause 8.2.16.2?
results.reference: to assign a TAI list to the UE
results.model_answer: The TAI list IE is included to provide the UE with a **new tracking area identity list**, optionally along with GUTI reallocation and/or a new DCN-ID, in the **GUTI REALLOCATION COMMAND** message.

results.question: What does the T3423 value IE indicate when included?
results.reference: a value for timer T3423
results.model_answer: When included, the **T3423 value IE indicates a value for timer T3423**. If it is not included, the UE uses the default value.

results.question: What is the title of clause 9.9.2.10 in TS 24.301?
results.reference: Supported codec list
results.model_answer: Clause 9.9.2.10 is titled **“Security protected NAS message.”**

results.question: What UE capability triggers the requirement for the network to include the Radio Priority IE?
results.reference: If the UE supports A/Gb mode
results.model_answer: If the UE supports **A/Gb mode** and the radio priority is modified, a network supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode shall include the **Radio Priority IE**.

results.question: What shall the network do if a lower layer failure occurs before receiving ATTACH COMPLETE from the UE?
results.reference: the network shall locally abort the attach procedure, enter state EMM-DEREGISTERED and shall not resend the message ATTACH ACCEPT
results.model_answer:
If a lower layer failure occurs before receiving **ATTACH COMPLETE**, the network shall:

- **locally abort the attach procedure**;
- enter **EMM-DEREGISTERED** state; and
- **not retransmit ATTACH ACCEPT**.

If a new GUTI was allocated, the network shall retain both the old and new GUTI as valid until the old GUTI can be considered invalid or the detached EMM context is released.

results.question: What TIN value shall a UE with ISR activated change to in order to locally deactivate ISR?
results.reference: "GUTI"
results.model_answer: The UE shall change its **TIN to “GUTI”** to locally deactivate ISR.

results.question: Under what condition does the UE use the default value for T3423?
results.reference: If this IE is not included
results.model_answer: The UE uses the default value for T3423 **when the T3423 value IE is not included**.

results.question: What shall the MME do if the ATTACH REQUEST is received with invalid or unacceptable UE security capabilities?
results.reference: the MME shall return an ATTACH REJECT message
results.model_answer:
The MME **shall return an ATTACH REJECT message**.

The EMM cause value to include is **up to network implementation**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the Release assistance indication IE according to TS 24.301?
results.reference: to inform the network whether
results.model_answer:
The **Release assistance indication IE** lets the UE inform the network of the expected data exchange after an uplink control-plane data transmission:

1. **No further uplink or downlink data** is expected; or  
2. **Only one downlink transmission** is expected, with no further uplink data.

This enables the network/MME to release the NAS signalling connection at the appropriate point.

results.question: Upon modification of which EPS bearer contexts shall the UE change its TIN to "GUTI" to locally deactivate ISR?
results.reference: any EPS bearer context which was activated before the ISR is activated in the UE
results.model_answer: The UE shall change its TIN to **“GUTI”** upon modification of **any EPS bearer context that was activated before ISR was activated in the UE**.

results.question: Which 3GPP specification clause defines the AUTN parameter according to TS 24.301?
results.model_answer: The AUTN parameter is defined in **3GPP TS 33.401, clause 6.1.1** (EPS authentication and key agreement procedure).

results.question: Which specific procedures, when failed, can lead to the UE selecting the ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH substate?
results.reference: attach or combined attach procedure
results.model_answer: “The substate EMM-DEREGISTERED.ATTEMPTING-TO-ATTACH is chosen in the UE if the **attach or combined attach procedure** failed due to a missing response from the network or due to the circumstances described in clauses 5.5.1.2.5, 5.5.1.2.6, 5.5.1.3.5 and 5.5.2.3.4.”

results.question: Upon deactivation of the last non-emergency EPS bearer context, when shall the UE change its TIN to "GUTI" to locally deactivate ISR?
results.reference: if the UE has only a PDN connection for emergency bearer services remaining
results.model_answer: The UE shall change its TIN to **“GUTI”** to locally deactivate ISR **upon deactivation of the last non-emergency EPS bearer context, if it has only a PDN connection for emergency bearer services remaining**.

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the TMSI status IE?
results.reference: if it has no valid TMSI available
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **TMSI status IE if no valid TMSI is available**.

results.question: What shall the UE include during a combined tracking area updating procedure when it lacks a valid TMSI?
results.reference: this IE
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **TMSI status IE** if no valid TMSI is available.

results.question: What is the primary purpose of the NAS security mode control procedure?
results.reference: to take an EPS security context into use, and initialise and start NAS signalling security between the UE and the MME with the corresponding EPS NAS keys and EPS security algorithms
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the NAS security mode control procedure is to take an EPS security context into use, and initialise and start NAS signalling security between the UE and the MME with the corresponding EPS NAS keys and EPS security algorithms.”

results.question: What may the UE do regarding the T3412 extended value IE when T3324 value IE is included?
results.reference: include this IE to request a particular T3412 value
results.model_answer: “The UE may include this IE to request a particular T3412 value if the T3324 value IE is included.”

results.question: Under what condition may the UE include the T3412 extended value IE?
results.reference: if the T3324 value IE is included
results.model_answer: The UE may include the **T3412 extended value IE** to request a particular T3412 value **if the T3324 value IE is included** (i.e. when requesting PSM).

results.question: For restrictions concerning concurrent running of the security mode control procedure with other security procedures, which specification and clause should be referenced?
results.model_answer: For restrictions concerning concurrent running of the security mode control procedure with other security-related procedures in the AS or core network, refer to **3GPP TS 33.401, clause 7.2.10**.

results.question: What does the length indication '?' mean for an Information Element?
results.reference: the maximum length of the IE is only constrained by link layer protocol
results.model_answer: “?” means that the maximum length of the Information Element is constrained only by the link layer protocol. This length indication is non-normative.

results.question: What does the table in each definition list about Information Elements?
results.reference: the Information Elements (IE) known in the message and the order of their appearance in the message

results.question: Which specific messages does the Serving PLMN rate control IE limit?
results.reference: uplink ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages including User data container IEs
results.model_answer:
The Serving PLMN rate control IE limits **uplink User data container IEs included in ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages**, for the corresponding PDN connection.

> “the UE shall store the serving PLMN rate control IE value and use the stored serving PLMN rate control value as the maximum allowed limit of uplink User data container IEs included in ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages for the corresponding PDN connection”

results.question: What does each definition given in clause 8.1 include regarding message significance?
results.reference: a brief description of the message direction and use, including whether the message has 1. Local significance, i.e. relevant only on the originating or terminating access 2. Access significance, i.e. relevant in the originating and terminating access, but not in the network 3. Dual significance, i.e. relevant in either the originating or terminating access and in the network; or 4. Global significance, i.e. relevant in the originating and terminating access and in the network
results.model_answer:
Each definition includes a brief description of the message direction and use, including whether the message has:

1. **Local significance** — relevant only on the originating or terminating access.  
2. **Access significance** — relevant in the originating and terminating access, but not in the network.  
3. **Dual significance** — relevant in either the originating or terminating access and in the network.  
4. **Global significance** — relevant in the originating and terminating access and in the network.

results.question: Over what time interval does the Serving PLMN rate control apply?
results.reference: per 6 minute interval
results.model_answer: “The indicated rate in a NAS procedure applies to the PDN connection the NAS procedure corresponds to, and the indicated rate is valid until the PDN connection is released.”

results.question: What are two examples of EMM common procedures that may be initiated?
results.reference: the EMM authentication and security mode control procedures
results.model_answer:
Two examples are:

- **EMM authentication procedure**
- **Security mode control procedure**

results.question: For restrictions applicable after handover or inter-system handover to S1 mode, which clause should be consulted?
results.reference: clause 5.5.3.2.3
results.model_answer: For restrictions applicable after handover or inter-system handover to S1 mode, see **clause 5.5.3.2.3**.

results.question: Which IE's inclusion allows the UE to include the T3412 extended value IE?
results.reference: the T3324 value IE
results.model_answer: The UE may include the **T3412 extended value IE** if it includes the **T3324 value IE** (and indicates support for the extended periodic timer value in the **MS network feature support IE**).

results.question: What type of information element is the Control plane service type?
results.reference: a type 1 information element
results.model_answer: The Control plane service type is a **type 1 information element**.

results.question: Which message's purpose does the Control plane service type information element specify?
results.reference: the CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST message
results.model_answer: “The purpose of the Control plane service type information element is to specify the purpose of the **CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST** message.”

results.question: When shall the Serving PLMN rate control IE be included?
results.reference: when the network wishes to indicate the maximum number of uplink ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages including User data container IEs the UE is allowed to send per 6 minute interval
results.model_answer: The Serving PLMN rate control IE shall be included by the MME, if serving PLMN rate control is enabled, in the **ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST** message during default EPS bearer context activation for a PDN connection established for **control plane CIoT EPS optimization**.

results.question: What entity may initiate EMM common procedures during the combined tracking area updating procedure?
results.reference: the MME
results.model_answer: During the combined tracking area updating procedure, **the MME (network)** may initiate EMM common procedures, e.g. EMM authentication and security mode control.

results.question: For what type of UE is core network selection specified in clause 4.8.4A.1 of 3GPP S 24.501?
results.reference: A UE that supports CIoT optimizations
results.model_answer: “A UE that supports CIoT optimizations performs core network selection as specified in clause 4.8.4A.1 of 3GPP TS 24.501.”

results.question: In which clause of TS 24.301 is Daylight saving time addressed?
results.reference: Clause 9.9.3.6
results.model_answer: Daylight saving time is addressed in **clause 9.9.3.8, “Daylight saving time”** of TS 24.301.

results.question: According to clause 5.3.19.1, what is performed as specified in clause 4.8.4A.1 of 3GPP S 24.501?
results.reference: core network selection
results.model_answer: “A UE that supports CIoT optimizations performs **core network selection** as specified in clause 4.8.4A.1 of 3GPP TS 24.501.”

results.question: What is the purpose of the Serving PLMN rate control IE according to clause 8.3.6.16?
results.reference: when the network wishes to indicate the maximum number of uplink ESM DATA TRANSPORT messages including User data container IEs the UE is allowed to send per 6 minute interval
results.model_answer: The Serving PLMN rate control IE indicates the serving-PLMN policy that limits the rate at which the UE may generate uplink NAS messages carrying user data over the control plane for the corresponding PDN connection. It applies only to PDN connections established using control-plane CIoT EPS optimization.

results.question: When shall the Protocol configuration options IE NOT be included in the message?
results.reference: if the Extended protocol configuration options IE is included in the message
results.model_answer: “The Protocol configuration options IE shall not be included if the Extended protocol configuration options IE is included in the message.”

results.question: What shall the UE do if there is a request for emergency services pending and the emergency bearer services indicator shows 'emergency bearer services in S1 mode not supported'?
results.reference: shall skip the requirements defined below in the present clause for the receipt of an ATTACH ACCEPT message including an EMM cause value, attempt to select GERAN or UTRAN radio access technology, select a setup message as defined in clause 5.3.7, proceed with appropriate MM specific procedures, and send the setup message
results.model_answer: The UE shall **skip the normal ATTACH ACCEPT / TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT EMM-cause handling requirements**, attempt to select **GERAN or UTRAN**, select the appropriate setup message per clause 5.3.7, proceed with the applicable MM-specific procedures, and send that setup message.

results.question: What UE configuration triggers inclusion of the Device properties IE?
results.reference: if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
results.model_answer:
A UE configured for **NAS signalling low priority** includes the **Device properties IE** in the appropriate NAS message, with the low-priority indicator set to *“MS is configured for NAS signalling low priority”*.

Specified exceptions require it to set the indicator to *“MS is not configured for NAS signalling low priority”* (e.g. emergency services, paging response, AC 11–15 UE, and applicable dual-priority cases).

results.question: What is the message type for the message sent by the network to provide EPS mobility management related data in response to a tracking area update request?
results.reference: TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT
results.model_answer: **TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT**.

results.question: What is the direction of the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message?
results.reference: network to UE
results.model_answer: Network to UE.

results.question: What shall the UE indicate in the EPS attach type IE when initiating a combined attach procedure?
results.reference: "combined EPS/IMSI attach"
results.model_answer: The UE shall indicate **“combined EPS/IMSI attach”** in the EPS attach type IE.

results.question: What EMM cause value and timer are set when a tracking area update request is rejected due to general NAS level mobility management congestion control?
results.reference: #22 "congestion" and assign a value for back-off timer T3346
results.model_answer: The network sets EMM cause value **#22 “congestion”** and assigns a value for the mobility-management back-off timer **T3346**.

results.question: Which entity sends the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message?
results.reference: the network
results.model_answer: The **network (MME)** sends the **AUTHENTICATION REJECT** message to the UE.

results.question: What is the purpose of the AUTHENTICATION REJECT message in 3GPP TS 24.301?
results.reference: to indicate that the authentication procedure has failed and that the UE shall abort all activities
results.model_answer: The **AUTHENTICATION REJECT** message is sent by the network to indicate that the UE’s EPS authentication procedure has failed and is rejected. It terminates the authentication procedure; upon receiving it, the UE aborts ongoing EMM signalling procedures, stops relevant timers, and enters **EMM-DEREGISTERED**.

results.question: For what services can a UE in CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2 use the combined attach procedure to attach?
results.reference: both EPS and non-EPS services, or both EPS services and "SMS only"
results.model_answer:
A UE in **CS/PS mode 1 or CS/PS mode 2** can use the combined attach procedure to attach:

- to **both EPS and non-EPS services**; or
- to **both EPS services and “SMS only”**.

It is also used to attach for **EPS services** when the UE is already IMSI-attached for non-EPS services.

results.question: What is the message type for the message sent to reject a modification of an active EPS bearer context?
results.reference: MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT
results.model_answer: **MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message?
results.reference: to reject a modification of an active EPS bearer context
results.model_answer: The **MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT** message is sent by the UE to the network to **reject a requested modification of an active EPS bearer context**. It includes the EPS bearer identity and an ESM cause indicating why the modification was rejected.

results.question: In which direction is the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message sent from the UE?
results.reference: UE to network
results.model_answer: UE to network (i.e. from the UE to the MME).

results.question: In which octet of every EPS Session Management message is the procedure transaction identity located?
results.reference: the second octet (octet 1a)
results.model_answer: The procedure transaction identity is located in the **second octet (octet 1a)** of every EPS Session Management (ESM) message, in bits 1 to 8.

results.question: What APN condition must be met for including the Protocol configuration options IE when the UE supports local IP address in TFT filter?
results.reference: the requested APN is not for UAS services
results.model_answer:
When the UE supports local IP address in the traffic flow aggregate description and TFT filter:

- **In NB-S1 mode:** the requested APN **is for UAS services**.
- **In WB-S1 mode:** the requested APN **is not for UAS services**.

results.question: In which type of messages does the second octet contain the procedure transaction identity?
results.reference: every EPS Session Management (ESM) message
results.model_answer:
“The EPS bearer identity and the procedure transaction identity are only used in messages with protocol discriminator EPS session management. Octet 1a with the procedure transaction identity shall only be included in these messages.”

Thus, the second octet (octet 1a) contains the procedure transaction identity in **EPS Session Management (ESM) messages**.

results.question: What EPS update status does the UE set when a tracking area update is rejected with EMM cause #12?
results.reference: EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED
results.model_answer: The UE sets the EPS update status to **EU3 ROAMING NOT ALLOWED** (and stores it according to clause 5.1.3.3).

results.question: Which entity can send the MODIFY EPS BEARER CONTEXT REJECT message according to clause 8.3.17.1?

results.question: What shall the UE do to avoid a synchronisation failure when receiving an AUTHENTICATION REQUEST message?

results.model_answer:
Examples are the UE’s **IMSI**, **GUTI**, and **KSI**.  

> “The network may initiate EMM common procedures, e.g. the identification, authentication and security mode control procedures, depending on the received information such as IMSI, GUTI and KSI.”

results.question: To whom is the GUTI assigned and the TAI list provided by the ATTACH ACCEPT message?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: The MME assigns the GUTI and provides the TAI list **to the UE** in the **ATTACH ACCEPT** message.

results.question: Under what condition shall the UE include the ESM message container IE?
results.reference: if it wants to send an ESM message to the network
results.model_answer: The UE shall include an **ESM message container IE** in a CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST **if it has pending IP, non-IP, or Ethernet user data to be sent via control-plane radio bearers**. It shall contain an **ESM DATA TRANSPORT** message.

results.question: Under what condition is the EMM cause IE included in a combined tracking area updating procedure?
results.reference: if the combined tracking area updating procedure was successful for EPS services only
results.model_answer: The EMM cause IE is included in the **TRACKING AREA UPDATE ACCEPT** when a **combined TA/LA update is accepted for EPS services only**, i.e. the non-EPS/CS location-update part was not successful. It indicates the reason for the non-EPS failure (e.g. cause #2, #16, or #18).

results.question: What does the network request with the Back-off timer value IE regarding procedure retry?
results.reference: a minimum time interval before procedure retry is allowed
results.model_answer:
The network uses the **Back-off timer value IE** to regulate the interval before the UE may retry the **same EPS session-management procedure** for the same **PLMN and APN combination**.

While the indicated timer is running, the UE is blocked from sending another corresponding ESM request; a value of zero permits re-attempt, while a deactivated timer prohibits re-attempt until the applicable clearing condition (typically switch-off or USIM removal).

results.question: What does the UE do if the service request procedure is triggered by a paging response and NAS signalling connection establishment is rejected?
results.reference: The UE stays in the current serving cell and applies normal cell reselection process.
results.model_answer: “The service request procedure shall not be started. The UE stays in the current serving cell and applies normal cell reselection process. During an implementation dependent time period, the service request procedure may be started when access for ‘terminating calls’ is granted or upon a cell change.”

results.question: When is the Device properties IE included according to clause 8.2.33.5?
results.reference: if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **Device properties IE** in the **CONTROL PLANE SERVICE REQUEST** message **if the UE is configured for NAS signalling low priority**.

results.question: What is the purpose of the ATTACH ACCEPT message?
results.reference: to assign a GUTI and provide the UE with a TAI list
results.model_answer:
The **ATTACH ACCEPT** message is sent by the MME to inform the UE that its EPS attach request has been accepted. It completes the network’s acceptance of registration and provides the UE with the assigned registration parameters, such as the TAI list, periodic TAU timer, and optionally a new GUTI.

When the UE requested PDN connectivity during attach, it can also carry the ESM message to activate the default EPS bearer context. The MME starts T3450 and awaits the UE’s **ATTACH COMPLETE** message.

results.question: Under what condition shall a network include the transaction identifier IE?
results.reference: supporting mobility from S1 mode to A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both
results.model_answer: The network shall include the **Transaction identifier IE** in an **ACTIVATE DEFAULT EPS BEARER CONTEXT REQUEST** when the message is sent during an **inter-system change from A/Gb mode or Iu mode to S1 mode**.

results.question: Under what condition can the MME include the T3346 value information element?
results.reference: when the NAS level mobility management congestion control is active
results.model_answer: The MME may include the **T3346 value IE** in an **ATTACH REJECT** (or other applicable EMM reject) when it is performing **NAS-level mobility-management congestion control** and rejects the UE’s mobility-management request due to congestion (typically EMM cause **#22 “congestion”**).

results.question: What UE capabilities trigger the requirement for the network to include the transaction identifier IE?
results.reference: the UE supports A/Gb mode or Iu mode or both
results.model_answer: The network shall include the **Transaction identifier IE** when the UE indicates support for **A/Gb mode and/or Iu mode**—i.e. support for inter-system mobility from S1 mode to **GERAN and/or UTRAN packet-switched access**.

results.question: What optimization must be selected for the SMF to include the IP header compression configuration IE?
results.reference: control plane CIoT 5GS optimization is selected
results.model_answer: The **control plane CIoT 5GS optimization** must be selected.

results.question: For a UE in 5GMM-CONNECTED mode with RRC inactive indication, what does the NAS provide to lower layers to enable access barring checks for access attempts identified by lower layers?
results.reference: the UE provides the applicable access identities to lower layers
results.model_answer: The NAS provides **the applicable access identities** to the lower layers.

results.question: Which subclause and table does a UE operating in SNPN access mode use to determine the applicable access category?
results.reference: subclause4.5.2A and the rules and actions defined in table4.5.2A.2
results.model_answer: A UE operating in SNPN access mode determines the applicable access category using **subclause 4.5.2A** and the rules/actions in **table 4.5.2A.2**.

results.question: What does a UE not operating as an IAB-node first perform when it needs to access the 5GS?
results.reference: first performs access control checks to determine if the access is allowed
results.model_answer: It first performs **access control checks** to determine whether the access is allowed.

results.question: What does the AUSF generate from the EMSK when it acts as the EAP-AKA' server?
results.reference: the KAUSF from the EMSK, and the KSEAF from the KAUSF
results.model_answer: When the AUSF acts as the EAP-AKA' server, it **generates the KAUSF from the EMSK, and the KSEAF from the KAUSF**.

results.question: What is an example of the single downlink data transmission mentioned in the Release assistance indication?
results.reference: acknowledgement or response to uplink data
results.model_answer: An example is **an acknowledgement or response to the uplink data**.

results.question: What does the receiver update after successful integrity protection validation?
results.reference: its corresponding locally stored NAS COUNT with the value of the estimated NAS COUNT for this NAS message
results.model_answer: “After successful integrity protection validation, the receiver shall update its corresponding locally stored NAS COUNT with the value of the estimated NAS COUNT for this NAS message.”

results.question: What type of registration should a UE indicate in the 5GS registration type IE when initiating registration for emergency services?
results.reference: "emergency registration"
results.model_answer: The UE shall indicate **“emergency registration”** in the **5GS registration type IE**.

results.question: What is the SMF responsible for in relation to the UE?
results.reference: The SMF is responsible for the session management functions to provide the PDU connectivity service to the UE via the 5GSM signalling between UE and SMF.
results.model_answer: “The SMF is responsible for the session management functions to provide the PDU connectivity service to the UE via the 5GSM signalling between UE and SMF.”

results.question: What message is sent if the AT_RESULT_IND attribute was included in the request but is not included in the corresponding response?
results.reference: an EAP-success message
results.model_answer: The AUSF or AAA server **shall send an EAP-Success message** (as specified in IETF RFC 5448) and **shall consider the procedure complete**.

results.question: What must the UE not be in for the UE radio capability ID IE to be included?
results.reference: not in NB-N1 mode
results.model_answer: The UE shall **not be in NB-N1 mode** for the UE radio capability ID IE to be included.

results.question: In the case where the 5GMM cause #21 "synch failure" is received, what may the core network do?
results.reference: renegotiate with the UDM/AUSF and provide the UE with new authentication parameters
results.model_answer: In the case where 5GMM cause #21 “synch failure” is received, **the core network may renegotiate with the UDM/AUSF and provide the UE with new authentication parameters.**

results.question: Which octets are included in the integrity protection for a SECURITY PROTECTED 5GS NAS MESSAGE?
results.reference: octet 7 to n, i.e. the Sequence number IE and the NAS message IE
results.model_answer: For a **SECURITY PROTECTED 5GS NAS MESSAGE**, integrity protection includes **octets 7 to n** — i.e. the **Sequence number IE** and the **NAS message IE**.

results.question: How are session management messages between UE and SMF transferred?
results.reference: The session management messages between UE and SMF are transferred via AMF as specified in subclause8.3
results.model_answer:
“The session management messages between UE and SMF are transferred via AMF as specified in subclause 8.3.”

They are carried as 5GSM messages piggybacked in specific 5GMM transport messages over the N1 NAS signalling connection.

results.question: In the first scenario described for the Release assistance indication, what type of data transmission is expected?
results.reference: no further uplink and no further downlink data transmission is expected
results.model_answer: “No further uplink and no further downlink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected.”

results.question: What does the sender use as input to the integrity protection algorithm?
results.reference: its locally stored NAS COUNT
results.model_answer:
“The sender shall use its locally stored NAS COUNT as input to the integrity protection algorithm.”

In addition, the algorithm inputs are the protected data, BEARER ID, DIRECTION bit, NAS COUNT, and the 5G NAS integrity key.

results.question: In which operational modes does a MUSIM UE not indicate support for paging indication for voice services during registration?
results.reference: A MUSIM UE operating in NB-N1 mode or in WB-N1 mode CE mode B does not indicate the support for paging indication for voice services during the registration procedure towards the network
results.model_answer: “A MUSIM UE operating in **NB-N1 mode** or in **WB-N1 mode CE mode B** does not indicate the support for paging indication for voice services during the registration procedure towards the network.”

results.question: What feature must both the UE and the network support for the inclusion of the UE radio capability ID IE?
results.reference: support RACS
results.model_answer: Both the UE and the network must support **UE radio capability signalling optimisation (RACS)** for inclusion of the **UE radio capability ID IE**.

results.question: Under what condition may the UE radio capability ID IE be included?
results.reference: if the UE is not in NB-N1 mode, both the UE and the network support RACS and the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE
results.model_answer: The UE radio capability ID IE **may be included if the UE is not in NB-N1 mode, both the UE and the network support RACS, and the network needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE.**

results.question: Under what condition may the SMF include the IP header compression configuration IE?
results.reference: the network accepts an IP PDU session type
results.model_answer:
The SMF may include the **IP header compression configuration IE** if:

- the network accepts an IP PDU session type;
- control plane CIoT 5GS optimization is selected; and
- the UE included the IP header compression configuration IE in the **PDU SESSION ESTABLISHMENT REQUEST** message.

results.question: What must a UE do if it stops fulfilling the condition to be considered a MUSIM UE and has negotiated support of MUSIM features?
results.reference: the UE shall initiate a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update to indicate that all the MUSIM features are not supported (except for the paging timing collision control)
results.model_answer: “If a UE stops fulfilling the condition to be considered a MUSIM UE … and the UE has negotiated support of one or more MUSIM features, then the UE shall initiate a registration procedure for mobility and periodic registration update to indicate that all the MUSIM features are not supported (except for the paging timing collision control).”

results.question: In the second scenario for the Release assistance indication, what is expected regarding uplink data transmission after the uplink data transmission?
results.reference: no further uplink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected
results.model_answer: In the second scenario, **no further uplink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected**. Only a single downlink data transmission is expected.

results.question: What capability does a UE have regarding PDU sessions and access networks?
results.reference: A UE may establish multiple PDU sessions, to the same data network or to different data networks, via 3GPP and via and Non-3GPP access networks at the same time
results.model_answer: “A UE may establish multiple PDU sessions, to the same data network or to different data networks, via 3GPP and via non-3GPP access networks at the same time.”

results.question: What does the UE inform the network about when it includes the Release assistance indication IE?
results.reference: whether no further uplink and no further downlink data transmission is expected; or only a single downlink data transmission (e.g. acknowledgement or response to uplink data) and no further uplink data transmission subsequent to the uplink data transmission is expected
results.model_answer: The UE informs the network that it has **no further uplink or downlink data to transmit or receive** for the indicated PDU session(s), thereby assisting the network in deciding whether user-plane and/or NAS signalling resources can be released.

results.question: When does a MUSIM UE indicate support for the paging restriction feature?
results.reference: If the UE has indicated support of the N1 NAS signalling connection release or the reject paging request or both and the UE supports the paging restriction, the UE indicates support of the paging restriction
results.model_answer:
A MUSIM UE indicates support for paging restriction **during the registration procedure** only when it:

- supports paging restriction; **and**
- has indicated support for **N1 NAS signalling connection release**, **reject paging request**, or both.

It does not indicate this support during registration for emergency services.

results.question: What is the purpose of the Rejected NSSAI IE according to clause 8.2.14.4?
results.reference: to inform the UE of one or more S-NSSAIs that were rejected by the network
results.model_answer: The **Rejected NSSAI IE** indicates one or more **S-NSSAIs rejected by the network**, together with the applicable rejection cause for each S-NSSAI. It enables the UE to store and handle those rejected S-NSSAIs appropriately—for example, not attempting to use a slice that is unavailable in the current PLMN/SNPN, registration area, due to failed/revoked NSSAA, or due to the maximum number of UEs being reached.

results.question: Over what time interval is the maximum uplink control plane user data limit applied?
results.reference: per 6 minute interval
results.model_answer: The maximum uplink control-plane user-data limit is applied **per 6-minute interval**.

results.question: For what type of data does the Serving PLMN rate control IE specify a maximum?
results.reference: uplink control plane user data
results.model_answer: The Serving PLMN rate control IE specifies the **maximum allowed rate of uplink control-plane user data** for the corresponding PDU session.

results.question: What action shall the AMF take if a NAS signalling message is received without integrity protection after secure exchange has been established?
results.reference: the NAS shall discard this message
results.model_answer: Once secure exchange of NAS messages has been established, the AMF NAS shall discard any NAS signalling message received without integrity protection.

results.question: Which NAS message can be processed by the AMF without integrity protection if the requested identification parameter is SUCI?
results.reference: IDENTITY RESPONSE (if requested identification parameter is SUCI)
results.model_answer: **IDENTITY RESPONSE** (when the requested identification parameter is **SUCI**) can be processed by the AMF without integrity protection.

results.question: What specific need must the network have to include the UE radio capability ID IE?
results.reference: needs to assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID to the UE
results.model_answer:
The network includes the **UE radio capability ID IE** when it wants to **assign a network-assigned UE radio capability ID** to a UE that supports RACS.

This is applicable only over **3GPP access** and when the UE is **not in NB-N1 mode**. The ID may be sent in a **REGISTRATION ACCEPT** or **CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND** message.

results.question: Under what condition does the network indicate support for the paging restriction feature?
results.reference: The network only indicates the support of the paging restriction together with the support of either N1 NAS signalling connection release or the reject paging request
results.model_answer:
The network indicates support for paging restriction only when:

- the UE has indicated support for paging restriction;  
- the network accepts paging restriction; and  
- the AMF has indicated support for **either N1 NAS signalling connection release or reject paging request, or both**, in the 5GS network feature support IE of the **REGISTRATION ACCEPT** message.

Specifically: “The network only indicates the support of the paging restriction together with the support of either N1 NAS signalling connection release or the reject paging request.”

results.question: What is the state of the UE when no PDU session exists?
results.reference: PDU SESSION INACTIVE
results.model_answer: The UE’s 5GSM entity is in the **PDU SESSION INACTIVE** state when no PDU session exists.

results.question: What shall the UE create to initiate the UE-requested PDU session release procedure?
results.reference: a PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message
results.model_answer: The UE shall create a **PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST** message.

results.question: What does the network do upon receipt of an AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE message?
results.reference: stops the timer T3560 and checks the correctness of RES*
results.model_answer:
Upon receipt of an **AUTHENTICATION RESPONSE** message, the network **stops timer T3560** and processes the response:

- For **5G AKA**, it checks the correctness of **RES\***.
- For **EAP-based primary authentication**, if the message contains the **EAP message IE**, the AMF handles the received EAP message.

results.question: What shall the AMF do with any NAS signalling message that has not successfully passed integrity check once secure exchange is established?
results.reference: the NAS in the AMF shall discard that message
results.model_answer: Once secure exchange of NAS messages has been established, the AMF shall discard any NAS signalling message that has not successfully passed the integrity check.

results.question: What information is included when retransmitting a previously failed uplink message?
results.reference: new sequence number and message authentication code information
results.model_answer: When retransmitting a previously failed uplink message, the UE uses **a new NAS sequence number and new message authentication code information**, avoiding restart of the whole procedure.

results.question: What shall the UE set the PLMN-specific N1 mode attempt counters to if a REGISTRATION REJECT message has been successfully integrity checked?
results.reference: the UE implementation-specific maximum value
results.model_answer:
For 5GMM cause **#27 “N1 mode not allowed”**, if the REGISTRATION REJECT has been successfully integrity checked, the UE shall set:

> “the PLMN-specific N1 mode attempt counter for 3GPP access and the PLMN-specific N1 mode attempt counter for non-3GPP access for that PLMN”

to the **UE implementation-specific maximum value**.

results.question: What 5GSM cause value indicates 'Semantic errors in packet filter(s)'?
results.model_answer: 5GSM cause value **#44** indicates **“Semantic errors in packet filter(s)”**.

results.question: What does the UE do if all QoS rules are evaluated and the UL user data packet is not associated with a QFI?
results.reference: the UE shall discard the UL user data packet
results.model_answer: “If all QoS rules are evaluated and the UL user data packet is not associated with a QFI, the UE shall discard the UL user data packet.”

results.question: What is the purpose of including the Disaster return wait range IE according to clause 8.2.9.8?
results.reference: to assign a new disaster return wait range to the UE
results.model_answer: The **Disaster return wait range IE** may be included **to assign a new disaster return wait range to the UE**.

results.question: For which PDU session types does the UE attempt to associate an UL user data packet with a QFI by evaluating QoS rules in order of precedence?
results.reference: For PDU session of IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6 or Ethernet PDU session type
results.model_answer:
For **IPv4, IPv6, IPv4v6, and Ethernet** PDU session types.

The UE evaluates the applicable signalled and derived QoS rules in increasing order of precedence values until it associates the UL packet with a QFI (or exhausts all rules).

results.question: Which technical specification defines the PDU session management state when no session is present?
results.model_answer: 3GPP **TS 24.501**, clause **6.1.1** defines the 5GSM state **PDU SESSION INACTIVE**: “In this state, no PDU session is established.”

results.question: What is the purpose of the Serving PLMN rate control IE?
results.reference: to indicate the maximum uplink control plane user data the UE is allowed to send per 6 minute interval
results.model_answer:
The **Serving PLMN rate control IE** provides the UE with the serving PLMN’s policy/rate limit for a PDU session. The UE stores it and uses it as the **maximum allowed rate of uplink control-plane user data** for that corresponding PDU session.

It applies only to PDU sessions established for **control-plane CIoT 5GS optimization**, is valid until the PDU session is released (or replaced through modification), and protects the serving PLMN’s AMF and E-UTRA signalling radio bearers from excessive control-plane user-data load.

results.question: Which procedure shall the UE initiate according to conditions given in subclause 5.6.1?
results.reference: shall initiate the service request procedure
results.model_answer: The UE shall initiate the **service request procedure** (according to the conditions given in subclause 5.6.1).

results.question: For a PDU session of unstructured PDU session type, what QFI does the UE associate with an UL user data packet?
results.reference: the QFI of the default QoS rule associated with the PDU session
results.model_answer: For an unstructured PDU session type, the UE associates the UL user data packet with **the QFI of the default QoS rule associated with the PDU session**.

results.question: Which entity receives the new disaster return wait range from the IE in clause 8.2.9.8?
results.reference: the UE
results.model_answer: The **UE** receives the new disaster return wait range. The *Disaster return wait range* IE “may be included to assign a new disaster return wait range to the UE.”

results.question: When can a procedure be re-initiated using a retransmission mechanism of the uplink message?
results.reference: When it is specified in the relevant procedure that it is up to the UE implementation to re-run the ongoing procedure that triggered that procedure
results.model_answer:
When the relevant procedure specifies that it is **up to UE implementation to re-run the ongoing procedure that triggered it**, the UE can typically re-initiate it by retransmitting the uplink message that previously failed transmission.

The retransmitted message uses a **new NAS sequence number and new message authentication code information**, avoiding a complete restart of the procedure.

results.question: To which subclause does clause 8.2.14.4 refer for specifications on rejection due to revocation?
results.reference: subclause4.6.2.4
results.model_answer: Clause 8.2.14.4 refers to **subclause 5.5.2.3.1** for specifications on rejection due to revocation.

results.question: What is performed by the lower layers according to the note in this clause?
results.reference: Marking of the UL user data packet with the QFI
results.model_answer: “The access barring check is performed by the lower layers.”

results.question: To what entity is a new disaster roaming wait range assigned by the IE?
results.reference: to the UE
results.model_answer: A new disaster roaming wait range is assigned **to the UE**.

results.question: What does the UE provide to the network to indicate which network slice(s) the UE wishes to register?
results.reference: network slicing information
results.model_answer:
The UE provides a **Requested NSSAI IE** in the **REGISTRATION REQUEST** message, containing the **S-NSSAI(s)** corresponding to the network slice(s) to which it intends to register.  

In roaming, it also provides the associated **mapped S-NSSAI(s)** when available (and may use the **Requested mapped NSSAI IE** where applicable).

results.question: What action is performed with the disaster return wait range as per clause 8.2.9.8?
results.reference: assign a new disaster return wait range
results.model_answer: “This IE may be included to assign a new disaster return wait range to the UE.”

results.question: What action does the Disaster roaming wait range IE perform regarding the wait range?
results.reference: assign a new disaster roaming wait range
results.model_answer: It assigns a **new disaster roaming wait range** to the UE.

results.question: When releasing a PDU session due to errors in QoS operations or packet filters, what shall the UE include in the PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST message?
results.reference: the 5GSM cause IE
results.model_answer: The UE shall include the **5GSM cause IE** in the **PDU SESSION RELEASE REQUEST** message, indicating the applicable error cause (e.g. #44, #45, #83, or #84).

results.question: What does the network provide to the UE to indicate which network slice(s) the UE is allowed to use?
results.reference: network slicing information
results.model_answer:
The network provides the UE with the **Allowed NSSAI** (Network Slice Selection Assistance Information), containing the **S-NSSAI(s)** of the network slices the UE is allowed to use.  

It is provided, for example, in a **REGISTRATION ACCEPT** message or updated through a **CONFIGURATION UPDATE COMMAND** message.

results.question: When the UE is in 5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED over 3GPP access, what shall it not do regarding non-3GPP access?
results.reference: shall not initiate registration over non-3GPP access
results.model_answer: When the UE is in **5GMM-REGISTERED-INITIATED over 3GPP access**, it **shall not initiate registration over non-3GPP access**.

results.question: What is the purpose of including the Disaster roaming wait range IE according to TS 24.501?
results.reference: to assign a new disaster roaming wait range to the UE
results.model_answer:
